-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > insert LocalScript,
-- rename it HeadlessSpiritToggle. (A LocalScript -- server Scripts cannot
-- read a controller, a keyboard, or a touch screen.)
-- What it does: for the ONE exclusive owner only, one on-screen button
-- (phone / tablet / mouse), the B key on PC, and the Y button on an
-- Xbox controller -- all firing the same RemoteEvent that Script 8
-- checks on the server.
--
-- FOR EVERYONE ELSE THIS SCRIPT DRAWS NOTHING AND BINDS NO KEYS.
-- There is no greyed-out button, no "locked" teaser, no shop link --
-- the form is a private gift, not an advert, so other players simply
-- never see that it exists in their controls.
--
-- SET THE SAME ID AS SCRIPT 8: replace the 0 below with your
-- daughter's UserId (roblox.com/users/<NUMBER>/profile). This copy
-- only controls what her screen shows. The real lock is Script 8's
-- server check -- if the two numbers ever disagree, the server wins:
-- a visible button with the wrong server ID does nothing when tapped.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE 0 with your daughter's UserId
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID == 0 or player.UserId ~= EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID then
	return -- not hers: no button, no keybinds, nothing to discover
end
local toggleEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeSpiritToggle")
-- Big, thumb-friendly button, bottom-right, clear of the jump button.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "HeadlessSpiritToggleGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "Spirit formButton"
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 52)
button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -186, 1, -128)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 15
button.Text = "Jade Spirit form: OFF"
button.Parent = gui
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = button
-- Second gate, defence in depth: Script 8 sets the server attribute
-- HasHeadlessJadeSpirit on the Player at join. If it ever reports
-- false (IDs pasted into the two Scripts disagree, or Script 8 is
-- missing), the button hides itself rather than sit there dead --
-- and firing the event anyway would still fail Script 8's own
-- server check, which is the only check that grants anything.
local function syncServerGate()
	if player:GetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit") == false then
		gui.Enabled = false
	else
		gui.Enabled = true
	end
end
syncServerGate()
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit"):Connect(syncServerGate)
local function flipLabel(character)
	-- Trust the server's attribute, not a local guess, so the shrine
	-- prompt in Script 8 and this button never disagree.
	local isOn = character and character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") == true
	button.Text = isOn and "Jade Spirit form: ON" or "Jade Spirit form: OFF"
end
local function requestToggle()
	toggleEvent:FireServer()
end
button.Activated:Connect(requestToggle)
-- PC keyboard: B. Xbox controller: Y (ButtonY). UserInputService
-- reports gamepad buttons through the same event as keys, so one
-- block covers both -- there is no separate "Xbox version".
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end -- do not fire while typing in chat
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
		requestToggle()
	end
end)
local function watchCharacter(character)
	flipLabel(character)
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsJadeSpirit"):Connect(function()
		flipLabel(character)
	end)
end
if player.Character then watchCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)

-- The visuals are YOURS alone, and the script is honest about why
-- that is safe: barrier Parts are non-collidable decoration for

local function showCard(text, seconds)

	local token = hideToken

		if hideToken == token then card.Visible = false end

deniedEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(zoneName, required, have)

	showCard("NEW ZONE UNLOCKED!\n" .. zoneName .. " — find its gate in the Grove.", 5)

function paintGates()
	local have = player:GetAttribute("ThrustTotal") or 0
	for _, gate in ipairs(GATE_KEYS) do
		local barrier = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneBarrier_" .. gate.Key, true)

					<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 21_ThrustMovement.client.lua
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > LocalScript
-- rename it ThrustMovement.
-- What it does: THRUST-TO-MOVE (Chapter 22). Every thrust of the
-- Twin Spear -- tap, click, or the R2 trigger on an Xbox
-- controller, all of which fire the Tool's Activated event -- gives
-- the wielder a burst of momentum. The spear is weapon and wings.
--
-- ANIMATION PRIORITY (Chapter 4): movement is choreographed
-- weapon-first, wings-second, body-last. The spear thrusts and
-- the burst follows the TIP; wing beats (the player's wings, and
-- the Daemon's at Stage 3+) sell the lift; the character's body
-- is carried by both. Animate the weapon and the wings and the
-- movement reads; animate the body alone and it never will.
--
-- WHY THIS LIVES ON THE CLIENT: momentum that waits for a server
-- round-trip feels like mud. The burst is applied locally, the
-- instant the thrust starts, on every device identically. Nothing
-- valuable is decided here: hits, damage, combo stages, and thrust
-- COUNTING are all resolved by Scripts 2 and 13 on the server,
-- which rate-cap and re-validate everything. A tampered movement
-- client can make its owner fly about -- it cannot mint a single
-- thrust, open a single gate, or win a single arena exchange,
-- because none of those read this Script's numbers.
--
-- THE FEEL, IN NUMBERS (Chapter 22 has the design table):
-- * Ground burst 17 studs/s, +2.5 per movement-chain link (thrusts
--   within 1.15 s of the last), capped at +12. Every 3rd chain link
--   is a LUNGE DASH: burst x1.5 and a hop.
-- * Air bursts aim with the camera (right stick on Xbox), hold a
--   glide line instead of falling, and cost more stamina. Three
--   air bursts per airborne stretch, hard cap -- there is no
--   infinite flight, however fast you thrust.
-- * Stamina 100: ground burst 16, air burst 30, lunge dash 24.
--   Regenerates 30/s standing on ground, 6/s in the air. A thrust
--   with too little stamina still thrusts -- it just doesn't dash.
-- * DAEMON GLIDE (Chapter 32): while the player's Daemon pet is
--   condensed beside them (the server sets the DaemonCondensed
--   attribute; this client only reads it), the Daemon's wing
--   beats add ONE extra air burst per airborne stretch and the
--   glide line holds longer -- weapon and Daemon, comboing to
--   move. Walking is always available; this is the skilled path.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local WINDOW = 1.15
local GROUND_BURST = 17
local CHAIN_BONUS = 2.5
local CHAIN_BONUS_CAP = 12
local LUNGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local MAX_AIR_BURSTS = 3
local function maxAirBursts()
	return player:GetAttribute("DaemonCondensed") and 4 or MAX_AIR_BURSTS
end
local STAMINA_MAX = 100
local COST = { Ground = 16, Air = 30, Lunge = 24 }
local stamina = STAMINA_MAX
local chain = 0
local lastThrustClock = 0
local airBursts = 0
local dashVelocity = nil
local dashAttachment = nil
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ThrustMovementGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 14)
barBack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 1, -64)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 34, 38)
barBack.Parent = gui
local bb = Instance.new("UICorner"); bb.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7); bb.Parent = barBack
local barFill = Instance.new("Frame")
barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203)
barFill.Parent = barBack
local bf = Instance.new("UICorner"); bf.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7); bf.Parent = barFill
local barLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
barLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 18)
barLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 1, -86)
barLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
barLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
barLabel.TextSize = 12
barLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235)
barLabel.Text = "PETAL STAMINA"
barLabel.Parent = gui
local function currentRoot()
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
		character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local function ensureDashObjects(root)
	if dashVelocity and dashVelocity.Parent == root then return end
	dashAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	dashAttachment.Name = "ThrustDashAttachment"
	dashAttachment.Parent = root
	dashVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	dashVelocity.Name = "ThrustDash"
	dashVelocity.Attachment0 = dashAttachment
	dashVelocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	dashVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	dashVelocity.MaxForce = 100000
	dashVelocity.Enabled = false
	dashVelocity.Parent = root
end
local function onThrust()
	local root, humanoid = currentRoot()
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	chain = (now - lastThrustClock <= WINDOW) and chain + 1 or 1
	lastThrustClock = now
	local isLunge = chain % 3 == 0
	local grounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	local cost = isLunge and COST.Lunge or (grounded and COST.Ground or COST.Air)
	if not grounded and airBursts >= maxAirBursts() then return end
	if stamina < cost then return end
	stamina -= cost
	if not grounded then airBursts += 1 end
	ensureDashObjects(root)

					<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 42_ShowcaseGui.client.lua
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > insert
-- LocalScript, rename it ShowcaseGui
-- What it does: the CLIENT half of Chapter 33 -- the Showcase
-- panel (Start Showcase, the pose wheel, title picker), the
-- local rendering of showcase acts and entrances (spotlights,
-- petal bursts, gold breath light, coil light rings), and the
-- Settings toggle that lets any player turn OTHER players'
-- effects down or off. It decides nothing: Script 41 owns
-- tiers, pedestals, cooldowns, titles, and sequence timing.
--
-- POSES: eight pose Animations are loaded by name from the
-- POSES table. Replace each 0 with your uploaded AnimationId
-- (Chapter 33, pose table). A pose with Id 0 is skipped with a
-- panel note -- a half-configured wheel fails safe.
-- Effects respect the local Effects setting on every event:
-- Full / Reduced (no screen flash, half particles) / Off.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local updateEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeShowcaseUpdate")
local requestEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeShowcaseRequest")
local entranceEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeEntrance")
local effectsMode = "Full" -- Full | Reduced | Off (local setting)
local POSES = {
	{ Id = "GuardianStance", AnimationId = 0 },
	{ Id = "SpearSalute", AnimationId = 0 },
	{ Id = "PetalBow", AnimationId = 0 },
	{ Id = "VictoryThrust", AnimationId = 0 },
	{ Id = "Meditate", AnimationId = 0 },
	{ Id = "PetPride", AnimationId = 0 },      -- keeper presents the Daemon
	{ Id = "DragonCoil", AnimationId = 0 },    -- keeper + Daemon coil pose
	{ Id = "TwinMirror", AnimationId = 0 },    -- pair pose with a nearby keeper
}
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ShowcaseGui"; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false; gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 150); panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -220, 0.5, -75)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 44, 36); panel.Parent = gui
local function button(text, y)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30); b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, y)
	b.Text = text; b.TextScaled = true; b.Parent = panel
	return b
end
button("Start Showcase", 8).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	requestEvent:FireServer("StartShowcase")
end)
button("Pose: Pet Pride", 44).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	playPose("PetPride")
end)
button("Pose: Dragon Coil", 80).MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	playPose("DragonCoil")
end)
local effectsButton = button("Effects: Full", 116)
effectsButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	effectsMode = effectsMode == "Full" and "Reduced" or effectsMode == "Reduced" and "Off" or "Full"
	effectsButton.Text = "Effects: " .. effectsMode
end)
function playPose(poseId)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	for _, pose in ipairs(POSES) do
		if pose.Id == poseId and pose.AnimationId ~= 0 then
			local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. pose.AnimationId
			local track = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track:Play()
			return
		end
	end
end
local function burst(root, color, count)
	if effectsMode == "Off" then return end
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment"); att.Parent = root
	local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	em.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	em.Rate = 0; em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
	em.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 11)
	em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	em.Parent = att
	em:Emit(effectsMode == "Reduced" and math.floor(count / 2) or count)
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(att, 2)
end
local function rootOf(userId)
	local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local char = p and p.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	local root = rootOf(data.UserId)
	if not root then return end
	if data.Effect == "GoldBreath" then
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80), 60) -- gold blossom breath light
	elseif data.Effect == "Finale" then
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 205), 80) -- petal-burst finale
	elseif data.Effect == "Coil" or data.Effect == "DesignTurn" then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 110); light.Range = 14; light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = root
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(light, data.Seconds or 4)
	end
end)
entranceEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	local root = rootOf(data.UserId)
	if not root then return end
	if data.Legend then
		-- Oakley's dedicated moment: a gold-and-petal double burst.
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80), 70)
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 205), 70)
	elseif data.Tier == "Epic" then
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 210), 40)
	elseif data.Tier == "Rare" then
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 220), 25)
	else
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 220), 10)
	end
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

--   companion it wakes (Sprite / Fox / Serpent / Bear Cub), and
--   three plain feel bars -- Reach, Swing, Speed -- drawn from the
--   numbers the server publishes in Chapter 34. Damage is printed
--   on every card, identical: 25. Kids compare feel, not power.
-- * Tap a card to PREVIEW: the card enlarges, the companion's name
--   and one-line temperament appear, and the confirm button arms.
--   Nothing is chosen until CONFIRM is pressed (two deliberate
--   taps, no accidental picks, no timer, no skip button).
-- * Confirm fires JadeWeaponChoice with the type NAME only. The
--   server validates the name against its own table, saves it, and
--   releases the player into World 1. This Gui then destroys
--   itself -- the choice screen exists exactly once per keeper.
-- * Xbox: D-pad moves between cards, A previews/confirms (the
--   focused card is outlined), B returns from preview to the row.
--
-- It computes nothing, grants nothing, and stores nothing.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

}
local gui, selected = nil, nil
local function bar(n)
	return string.rep("■", n) .. string.rep("□", 5 - n)
end
local function destroy()
	if gui then gui:Destroy(); gui = nil end
	selected = nil
end
local function build()
	destroy()
	gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "WeaponChoiceGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	title.Parent = gui
	local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")

	sub.TextSize = 16

	sub.Parent = gui
	local confirm = Instance.new("TextButton")
	confirm.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 52)
	confirm.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 1, -84)
	confirm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 72, 44)

	confirm.TextSize = 18
	confirm.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 244)
	confirm.Text = "CHOOSE A CARD FIRST"
	confirm.AutoButtonColor = true
	confirm.Parent = gui
	local cc = Instance.new("UICorner"); cc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); cc.Parent = confirm
	for i, card in ipairs(CARDS) do
		local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(196, 250)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (i - 2.5) * 208 - 98, 0, 130)
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(58, 38, 30)

		b.TextSize = 15

		b.Text = string.format("%s\n\nwakes %s\n%s\n\nReach %s\nSwing %s\nSpeed %s\n\nDamage 25 — same as every weapon",
			string.upper(card.Type), card.Companion, card.Temper, bar(card.Reach), bar(card.Swing), bar(card.Speed))
		b.Parent = gui
		local bc = Instance.new("UICorner"); bc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12); bc.Parent = b
		b.Activated:Connect(function()

			confirm.Text = "THIS IS MY WEAPON — THE " .. string.upper(card.Type)
			confirm.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(176, 84, 122)
		end)
	end
	confirm.Activated:Connect(function()
		if not selected then return end
		choiceEvent:FireServer(selected)
		destroy()
	end)
end
openEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(build)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
	if processed or not gui then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then selected = nil end
end)

-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > LocalScript,
-- rename it WingsGui
-- What it does: the wing panel (Chapter 35). Four wing cards -- Feathered,
-- Crystal, Butterfly, Dragon -- each drawn ONLY from the server's
-- OwnsWing<Type> attributes (Script 47): owned wings show their
-- flight style (Climb / Glide / Turn, as words: High / Even / Soft),
-- unowned wings show their unlock path as plain text -- never a
-- price, because no wing is sold. Selecting a card fires
-- JadeWingSelect with the type NAME; the server re-checks
-- ownership and decides. Flight itself (F / Xbox ButtonY, Stage 3)
-- stays in Script 40 exactly as before; this panel only chooses
-- which wings the Daemon and the Susanoo wear.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local selectEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeWingSelect")
local WINGS = {
	{ Name = "Feathered", Unlock = "Yours with flight itself — Susanoo Stage 3", Style = "Glides farthest; the starter wings" },
	{ Name = "Crystal",   Unlock = "Reach the Crystal Deep, then craft at the Workbench (25 Blooms)", Style = "Climbs hardest" },
	{ Name = "Butterfly", Unlock = "Free 100 Thorn Husks", Style = "Turns tightest, glides far" },
	{ Name = "Dragon",    Unlock = "Hold the Tree through 10 Hollow assaults", Style = "Climbs hard, turns wide — the endgame wings" },
}
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -246, 0, 16)

panel.Parent = gui
local pc = Instance.new("UICorner"); pc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10); pc.Parent = panel
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 22)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 6)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 13
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 230)
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Text = "WINGS"
title.Parent = panel
local body = Instance.new("TextLabel")
body.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 118)
body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 28)
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
body.TextSize = 11
body.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(246, 228, 218)
body.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
body.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
body.TextWrapped = true
body.Parent = panel
local function refresh()
	local any = false
	local lines = {}
	local worn = player:GetAttribute("WingType")
	for _, w in ipairs(WINGS) do
		if player:GetAttribute("OwnsWing" .. w.Name) then
			any = true
			table.insert(lines, (worn == w.Name and "▶ " or "• ") .. w.Name .. " — " .. w.Style)
		else
			table.insert(lines, "· " .. w.Name .. " — " .. w.Unlock)
		end
	end
	gui.Enabled = any
	body.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
for _, w in ipairs(WINGS) do
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnsWing" .. w.Name):Connect(refresh)
	-- cards are the lines themselves in this compact panel; a tap on
	-- the panel cycles to the next OWNED wing (server validates).
end

			if player:GetAttribute("OwnsWing" .. w.Name) then table.insert(ownedList, w.Name) end
		end
		if #ownedList == 0 then return end
		local worn = player:GetAttribute("WingType")
		local idx = 1
		for i, n in ipairs(ownedList) do if n == worn then idx = i end end
		selectEvent:FireServer(ownedList[(idx % #ownedList) + 1])
	end
end)
refresh()

					<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 50_ColosseumGui.client.lua
-- What it does: the Colosseum spectator experience (Chapter 46):
-- the pay-to-view ticket shop, the camera director (overhead,
-- hill cam, contestant player-cams, exclusive pit/gate cams),
-- the live scoreboard, and the FREE prediction panel.
--
-- This client buys nothing by itself and grants nothing: it only
-- opens Roblox's own purchase prompts. The server (Script 49 via
-- Script 10's receipts) decides who holds a ticket. Camera work
-- is local and cosmetic -- a tampered client can point its own
-- camera anywhere, and gains nothing, because the live STANDS
-- (the place, the feed panel, the prediction window) are what
-- the ticket gates, and those are server-checked teleports.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeColosseum")
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ColosseumGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 210)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -336, 0, 16)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 32, 28)
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = gui
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 6)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 235)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Text = "COLOSSEUM — LIVE"
title.Parent = panel
local feed = Instance.new("TextLabel")
feed.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 110)
feed.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 38)
feed.BackgroundTransparency = 1
feed.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 245, 240)
feed.Font = Enum.Font.Code
feed.TextSize = 13
feed.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
feed.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
feed.Text = "Waiting for the next match…"
feed.Parent = panel
-- ---------- camera director --------------------------------------
-- Modes: Stands (your seat) / Overhead / Hill / PlayerCam (cycles
-- the living contestants) / Pit & Gate (premium exclusive angles,
-- shown only after the server grants LiveAccess).
local mode = "Stands"
local camIndex = 0
local roster = {}
local hasLive = false
local function setMode(nextMode)
	mode = nextMode
	if mode == "Stands" then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	elseif mode == "Overhead" then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
			Vector3.new(0, 190, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
	elseif mode == "Hill" then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		local hill = workspace:FindFirstChild("ColosseumHillCam")
		if hill then camera.CFrame = hill.CFrame end
	elseif mode == "Pit" or mode == "Gate" then
		if not hasLive then return end -- exclusive angles are paid-tier
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		local part = workspace:FindFirstChild("Colosseum" .. mode .. "Cam")
		if part then camera.CFrame = part.CFrame end
	elseif mode == "PlayerCam" then
		camIndex += 1
		local alive = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(roster) do
			if entry.Alive then table.insert(alive, entry.Name) end
		end
		if #alive == 0 then return end
		local target = Players:FindFirstChild(alive[((camIndex - 1) % #alive) + 1])
		local hum = target and target.Character
			and target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			camera.CameraSubject = hum
		end
	end
end
-- ---------- buttons ----------------------------------------------
local function makeButton(text, y, fn)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -12, 0, 30)
	b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8 + ((y % 2) * 160), 0, 152 + math.floor(y / 2) * 0)
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 125, 100)
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	b.TextSize = 13
	b.Text = text
	b.Parent = panel
	b.Activated:Connect(fn)
	return b
end
makeButton("WATCH LIVE", 0, function()
	remote:FireServer("EnterLiveStands")
end)
makeButton("CAMERA: NEXT", 1, function()
	local order = { "Stands", "Overhead", "Hill", "PlayerCam", "Pit", "Gate" }
	for i, name in ipairs(order) do
		if name == mode then
			setMode(order[(i % #order) + 1])
			return
		end
	end
	setMode("Overhead")
end)
-- ---------- server feed -------------------------------------------
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
	if kind == "State" then
		roster = data.Roster or {}
		panel.Visible = true
		local lines = {
			("Phase: %s   Pool: %d Spend"):format(data.Phase, data.Pool),
			("Standing: %d contestants"):format(data.Alive),
		}
		for _, entry in ipairs(roster) do
			table.insert(lines, ("%s %s — hill %ds"):format(
				entry.Alive and "●" or "○", entry.Name, entry.HillTime))
		end
		feed.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	elseif kind == "NeedTicket" then
		-- The shop is three honest buttons on the ticket card in
		-- the lobby build (Chapter 46); the first is wired here:
		-- one match, live, 49 Robux, via Roblox's own prompt.
		if data.TicketProductId and data.TicketProductId > 0 then
			MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, data.TicketProductId)
		end
	elseif kind == "LiveAccess" then
		hasLive = true
		panel.Visible = true
		setMode("Overhead")
	elseif kind == "Winner" then
		feed.Text = ("WINNER TAKES ALL: %s — pool of %d Spend"):format(
			data.Name, data.Pool)
	elseif kind == "NoWinner" then
		feed.Text = ("NO WINNER — the horde took everyone. Pool of %d rolls over."):format(
			data.Rollover)
	end
end)
print("[Jade Spirit] ColosseumGui ready.")
-- ---------- View Credit (Chapter 47 loyalty loop) ----------------
local creditLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
creditLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 20)
creditLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 184)
creditLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
creditLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 205)
creditLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
creditLabel.TextSize = 12
creditLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
creditLabel.Text = "View Credit: 0 min (earn it in the Sales Vault)"
creditLabel.Parent = panel
makeButton("WATCH ON CREDIT", 0, function()
	remote:FireServer("EnterStandsOnCredit")
end).Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 152)
remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, data)
	if kind == "ViewCredit" then
		panel.Visible = true
		creditLabel.Text = ("View Credit: %d min%s"):format(
			math.floor(data.Balance or 0),
			data.Denied and " — 10 min minimum to enter on credit" or "")
	elseif kind == "CreditEmpty" then
		creditLabel.Text = "View Credit spent — the replay is free, or any Vault purchase refills the bank."
		setMode("Stands")
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

				<Properties>
					<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 59_CodeGateGui.client.lua
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > LocalScript,
-- rename it CodeGateGui. Draws the GATE CARD (Chapter 53): after
-- every code-gate approach the server (Script 58) sends the verdict
-- and this card shows it in the game's own language -- the module's
-- name, what it decided, why, and the measured residual. The card
-- is a window into the laboratory: players SEE Taylor's code judge
-- their live play, with the number it judged by. The client decides
-- nothing: no verdict is computed or trusted here.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "JadeGateCardGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local card = Instance.new("Frame")
card.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(340, 132)
card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 1, -160)
card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 34, 30)
card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
card.Visible = false
card.Parent = gui
local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = card
local function label(y, size, bold)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, size + 6)
	l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y)
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 245, 235)
	l.Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
	l.TextSize = size
	l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.TextWrapped = true
	l.Parent = card
	return l
end
local title = label(6, 15, true)
local verdictLabel = label(32, 13, true)
local reasonLabel = label(58, 12, false)
reasonLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 44)
local residualLabel = label(104, 11, false)
local cardEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeGateCard")
cardEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(key, moduleId, mode, verdict, admitted)
	title.Text = "⚙ " .. tostring(key) .. " — module " .. tostring(moduleId)
	verdictLabel.Text = admitted and "ADMITTED"
		or (verdict.Action == "REPAIR" and "REPAIRED — ADMITTED" or "REFUSED")
	verdictLabel.TextColor3 = admitted
		and Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 190) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 150)
	reasonLabel.Text = tostring(verdict.Reason or "")
		.. (mode == "SHADOW" and "  (shadow: the classic rule decided)" or "")
	residualLabel.Text = verdict.Residual ~= nil
		and ("measured residual: " .. string.format("%.3f", verdict.Residual)) or ""
	card.Visible = true
	task.delay(6, function() card.Visible = false end)
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

-- is re-validated there. A tampered client can draw anything;
-- it can wear nothing it has not bought.

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 01_GameManager.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > GameManager (Server Script)
-- Creates leaderstats, saves data, gives the Twin Spear on spawn.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14 has the full audit):
-- * Every number in leaderstats is written by SERVER Scripts only.
--   No RemoteEvent in this game accepts a currency amount from a
--   client -- there is nothing for an exploiter to "fire with a
--   bigger number". If you ever add such a Remote, you own the hole.
-- * Load failure must never become a save. If the DataStore read
--   fails (outage, throttling), the session is flagged and
--   saveData() refuses to run -- otherwise a player who joins
--   during an outage would overwrite a real balance with the
--   0-Shard fallback. Balances are solvency.
-- * Loaded values are clamped to sane ranges before use, so a
--   corrupted or hand-edited save can never mint negative or
--   astronomical currency into the live economy.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_v1")
local MAX_STAGE = 12 -- Checkpoint_1 .. Checkpoint_12 (Script 5)
local function clean(value, fallback, max)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if value == nil or value ~= value then return fallback end -- nil / NaN
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, max)
end
local function loadData(player)
	-- Up to 3 attempts: a transient DataStore error should not cost
	-- a player their balance OR lock them out of saving for a session.
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			if type(data) == "table" then
				return {
					Shards = clean(data.Shards, 0, 1000000000),
					Blooms = clean(data.Blooms, 0, 100000000),
					Stage  = clean(data.Stage, 0, MAX_STAGE),
				}, true
			end
			return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, true -- new player
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, false
end
local function saveData(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled") then return end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local data = {
		Shards = clean(stats.Shards.Value, 0, 1000000000),
		Blooms = clean(stats.Blooms.Value, 0, 100000000),
		Stage  = clean(stats.Stage.Value, 0, MAX_STAGE),
	}
	-- UpdateAsync, not SetAsync: the write is atomic per key, so two
	-- servers can never interleave half a save over the other.
	pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function()
			return data
		end)
	end)
end
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local data, loaded = loadData(player)
	-- Other systems read these two attributes before they grant
	-- anything. DataLoaded=false means "hands off this player's
	-- economy this session" (Script 10 returns NotProcessedYet for
	-- receipts instead of granting into an unloaded balance).
	player:SetAttribute("DataLoaded", loaded)
	player:SetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled", not loaded)
	if not loaded then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Data load failed for " .. player.Name
			.. " -- playing unsaved this session; balance is protected.")
	end
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player
	local shards = Instance.new("IntValue")
	shards.Name = "Shards"
	shards.Value = data.Shards
	shards.Parent = stats
	local blooms = Instance.new("IntValue")
	blooms.Name = "Blooms"
	blooms.Value = data.Blooms
	blooms.Parent = stats
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = data.Stage
	stage.Parent = stats
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		-- Give the Twin Spear -- once. Without this check every
		-- respawn stacked another copy in the Backpack (duplication
		-- of a Tool is untidy here and a real exploit in games where
		-- tools can be dropped or sold; the habit matters).
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if template
			and not player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
			and not character:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then
			template:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
		end
		-- Respawn at the player's highest obby checkpoint
		local spawnFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
		if spawnFolder and stage.Value > 0 then
			local pad = spawnFolder:FindFirstChild("Checkpoint_" .. stage.Value)
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if pad and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = pad.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end
-- Script 10 (Monetization) fires this after a paid grant so the new
-- balance is persisted immediately, not at the next autosave: a
-- server crash in between must not eat a purchase a child paid for.
local saveEvent = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeRequestSave")
if not saveEvent then
	saveEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	saveEvent.Name = "JadeRequestSave"
	saveEvent.Parent = ServerStorage
end
saveEvent.Event:Connect(function(player)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		saveData(player)
	end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player) -- late-loading Script safety
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveData)
-- Autosave every 2 minutes
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(120)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			saveData(player)
		end
	end
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		saveData(player)
	end
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

-- Location: Inside any collectable Part (Server Script, ONE per Part)
-- Name the Part "SakuraShard" (+10 Shards) or "CrystalBloom" (+1 Bloom).
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * Touched is physics: a modified client controls its own

-- * Exactly ONE copy of this Script per Part. Two copies = two
--   grants per touch. The PickupScriptActive attribute below turns
--   a second pasted copy inert instead of a duplication exploit.
-- * The reward table is a server constant keyed by the Part's own
--   name. A player cannot rename a server Part, so the amount can

local part = script.Parent
if part:GetAttribute("PickupScriptActive") then return end
part:SetAttribute("PickupScriptActive", true)

	SakuraShard = { Stat = "Shards", Amount = 10 },
	CrystalBloom = { Stat = "Blooms", Amount = 1 },
}
local reward = REWARDS[part.Name]
if not reward then return end

local MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE = 12 -- HRP to pickup, in studs

-- Make it pretty: spin and bob
task.spawn(function()
	local start = part.CFrame
	local t = 0

		t += 0.05
		part.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t) * 0.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t, 0)

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit and hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or cooldown[player] then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	if (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE then
		return -- touch claimed from implausibly far away; ignore it
	end

	if stats and stats:FindFirstChild(reward.Stat) then

	end

	part.CanTouch = false
	task.wait(RESPAWN_SECONDS)
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.CanTouch = true

	cooldown[player] = nil

-- Location: ServerScriptService > CheckpointSystem (ONE Server Script)
-- Setup: Folder in Workspace named "Checkpoints". Inside it, Parts named
-- Checkpoint_1, Checkpoint_2, Checkpoint_3 ... in order along the obby.
-- Make each pad jade green, Material = Neon, CanCollide = true.
--
-- SECURITY NOTE (Chapter 14): progress is SEQUENTIAL now. The first
-- edition saved any higher pad a character touched -- so one lucky
-- glitch, one fling exploit, or one friend's launched character
-- landing on Checkpoint_12 permanently banked the whole obby into
-- the DataStore. This version only ever advances a player by one
-- stage at a time: stage N+1 is accepted, anything further ahead is
-- ignored until the stages between are honestly touched in order.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
for _, pad in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	if pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		local stageNumber = tonumber(string.match(pad.Name, "%d+"))
		if stageNumber then
			pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if not player then return end
				local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
				local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
				if not stats then return end
				local current = stats.Stage.Value
				if stageNumber == current + 1 then
					stats.Stage.Value = stageNumber
					local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
					light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190)
					light.Range = 14
					light.Parent = pad
					task.delay(1, function() light:Destroy() end)
				end
				-- stageNumber <= current: already banked, no-op.
				-- stageNumber > current + 1: a skip. Ignored, and
				-- deliberately not saved -- see the note above.
			end)
		end
	end
end

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 06_ShopAndTeleports.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > ShopAndTeleports (Server Script)
-- Teleports: Parts in Workspace named Teleport_Grove, Teleport_Obby,
-- Teleport_Arena. Touching one moves the player to the matching
-- SpawnLocation named Spawn_Grove, Spawn_Obby, Spawn_Arena.
-- Earn-shop: a Part named "ShopPad" in the Grove sells ONE earn-only
-- cosmetic, the Grove Trail, for Shards earned in play.
--
-- SECURITY / SOLVENCY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * ProximityPrompt.Triggered hands the server a player object, but
--   a modified client can fire prompts from across the map. Every
--   prompt handler in this game therefore re-checks, on the server,
--   that the player's character is genuinely within reach of the
--   pad before money moves. Distance is checked here, in the quest
--   Script 7, and at the spirit form shrine in Script 8.
-- * Ownership lives on the PLAYER, not the character (the first
--   edition stored it on the character, so it vanished on respawn
--   and the same trail could be charged for again and again -- a
--   shard drain for honest players). It is checked before charging,
--   and the charge + grant happen back-to-back with no yield
--   between them, so the prompt cannot be double-fired mid-sale.
-- * The Robux Petal Trail PACK is a different item, sold only by
--   Script 10. Nothing sold for Shards here is also sold for Robux:
--   one item, one currency, one seller -- see the audit in Ch. 6.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local function characterNear(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end
local DESTINATIONS = {
	Teleport_Grove = "Spawn_Grove",
	Teleport_Obby = "Spawn_Obby",
	Teleport_Arena = "Spawn_Arena",
}
local teleportCooldown = {} -- [player] = true for 1s after a hop
for partName, spawnName in pairs(DESTINATIONS) do
	local pad = workspace:WaitForChild(partName, 10)
	local spawn = workspace:WaitForChild(spawnName, 10)
	if pad and spawn then
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if not player or teleportCooldown[player] then return end
			local root = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			teleportCooldown[player] = true
			root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			task.delay(1, function() teleportCooldown[player] = nil end)
		end)
	end
end
-- Earn-only cosmetic shop: Grove Trail for 500 Shards (play-earned)
local TRAIL_PRICE = 500
local shopPad = workspace:WaitForChild("ShopPad", 10)
if shopPad then
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Buy Grove Trail (" .. TRAIL_PRICE .. " Shards)"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit Shop"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.Parent = shopPad
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if not characterNear(player, shopPad, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then
			return -- prompt fired from out of reach: not a sale
		end
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local character = player.Character
		if not stats or not character then return end
		if player:GetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail") then return end -- own it: never charge twice
		if stats.Shards.Value < TRAIL_PRICE then return end
		-- Charge and grant together, with no yield between: a second
		-- Triggered arriving in the same frame sees the attribute set.
		stats.Shards.Value -= TRAIL_PRICE
		player:SetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail", true)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		if root and waist then
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", waist)
			local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
			trail.Name = "GroveTrail"
			trail.Attachment0 = a0
			trail.Attachment1 = a1
			trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 170))
			trail.Lifetime = 0.6
			trail.Parent = character
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	teleportCooldown[player] = nil
end)

-- Location: Inside the Jade Spirit NPC Model in the Grove (Server Script)
-- NPC setup: Model named "JadeSpiritNPC" with HumanoidRootPart.
-- Quest: Free 3 Thorn Husks, earn 150 Shards. This Script creates
-- its own ProximityPrompt on the NPC.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server before any
--   quest state or currency moves (prompts can be fired remotely
--   by modified clients -- see Script 6's note).
-- * The reward is a server constant, paid once: completion latches
--   the player's state to DONE in the same handler run, before the
--   Shards are added, so a double-fired prompt in the same frame
--   sees a completed quest and pays nothing the second time.
-- * _G.JadeQuestAdd is a server-only bridge (only server Scripts
--   share _G; a client has no path to it). It still validates its
--   inputs: the target must have an ACTIVE quest and the amount is
--   clamped to 1 per call, so no caller -- ours or a future one --
--   can fast-forward a quest with a giant number.
-- * Progress is per-session by design (persisting it is Chapter
--   13's update). The reward gate means the 150 Shards can be
--   earned at most once per session, and only after 3 real frees.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local npc = script.Parent
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Talk"
prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
prompt.Parent = root
local QUEST_GOAL = 3
local QUEST_REWARD = 150
local progress = {} -- [player] = number of frees, or "DONE"
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local cRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not cRoot then return end
	if (cRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
		> prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then
		return -- fired from out of reach: not a conversation
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local state = progress[player]
	if state == nil then
		progress[player] = 0
		print(player.Name .. " accepted: Free 3 Thorn Husks in the Grove!")
	elseif state == "DONE" then
		print(player.Name .. " has already completed the Grove quest.")
	elseif state >= QUEST_GOAL then
		progress[player] = "DONE" -- latch BEFORE paying: no double pay
		stats.Shards.Value += QUEST_REWARD
		print(player.Name .. " completed the Grove quest! +" .. QUEST_REWARD .. " Shards")
	else
		print(player.Name .. " quest progress: " .. state .. " / " .. QUEST_GOAL)
	end
end)
-- Called by Script 4 (ThornHusk) when a husk is freed:
--   if _G.JadeQuestAdd then _G.JadeQuestAdd(player, 1) end
_G.JadeQuestAdd = function(player, amount)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	local state = progress[player]
	if typeof(state) ~= "number" then return end -- no active quest
	progress[player] = state + math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 1)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	progress[player] = nil
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 08_HeadlessSpirit.server.lua  (EXCLUSIVE VERSION)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it HeadlessSpirit
-- What it does: gives ONE named player -- and nobody else -- the
-- Headless Jade Spirit form: the real body is hidden, NO skull form is
-- added (that empty head slot is what makes her truly headless), and a
-- pale-jade neon form rig is welded onto the R15 body so she walks,
-- jumps, climbs, and thrusts the spear as a jade spirit form, with her
-- pink Spirit Bow floating where the head would be.
-- DEFINITIVE DESIGN (Chapter 36): clean jade crystal, NO moss, the
-- Gold Dragon worn as a scarf (Script 39's Scarf Rest), and ONE
-- double-sized angel wing on her back (the DefinitiveWing form
-- part below). No clothes: the wing is the outfit.
--
-- ============================================================
-- EXCLUSIVE -- READ THIS BEFORE YOU PASTE ANYTHING ELSE
-- ============================================================
-- * This form is a private family gift. It is NOT a Game Pass, NOT a
--   Developer Product, NOT in the shop, and it must never be added
--   to one. There is no product ID for it anywhere in this package.
-- * The only key is the UserId check below, on the SERVER. A player
--   cannot edit a server Script, fire the RemoteEvent all day, or
--   copy the shop GUI and get in -- toggle() checks first, every time.
--
-- WHY THE LOCK CANNOT BE SPOOFED (Chapter 14):
-- * player.UserId is assigned by Roblox's own backend when the
--   account joins. It is not sent by the client, not read from the
--   character, and cannot be changed by any Script at runtime.
--   DisplayName and Name ARE copyable -- which is why this
--   lock never looks at them.
-- * OnServerEvent's first argument is the Player object ROBLOX
--   supplies for the connection that fired the event. An exploiter
--   firing FireServer(herPlayerObject) changes nothing: extra
--   arguments are ignored, and the event still arrives labelled
--   with the EXPLOITER's own player object, which fails the check.
-- * The check is recomputed from UserId on EVERY toggle. No
--   attribute, BoolValue, GUI state, or "already unlocked" flag is
--   ever trusted -- attributes a client can influence are treated
--   as decoration by every Script in this game.
-- * Toggles are rate-limited to one per second per player, so even
--   the owner spamming the event (or an exploiter spamming it in
--   her name -- which still fails the check) cannot clone rigs
--   fast enough to lag the server.
-- * The SpiritRig template lives in ServerStorage, which clients
--   cannot see or copy. If it is ever moved to ReplicatedStorage
--   or Workspace, its shapes become public -- keep it in
--   ServerStorage.
-- * FAIL CLOSED: while EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID is still 0, NOBODY can use
--   the form -- not even the game owner. That is on purpose, so a
--   half-finished setup can never leak it to everyone by accident.
--
-- SET THE ID (one minute, do it before publishing):
--   1. Log in as your daughter on roblox.com and open her profile.
--   2. The address bar reads roblox.com/users/<NUMBER>/profile --
--      that number is her UserId. It never changes, even if her
--      display name or username does. (Usernames can be copied by
--      other players. UserIds cannot. That is why the lock uses it.)
--   3. Put that number in place of the 0 on the next line, AND in
--      Script 9 in the same place. Script 9's copy only hides the
--      button for everyone else -- this server copy is the real lock.
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE 0 with your daughter's UserId
local function isExclusiveOwner(player)
	return EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID
end
-- Her spirit form: pale jade, glowing -- a body of living jade
-- light, solid and smooth, with no head: the form is the First
-- Guardian's, and it is hers and hers only.
local SPIRIT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
local SPIRIT_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.Neon
-- Form part name in SpiritRig -> R15 body Part it welds to.
-- THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO HEAD PART IN THIS LIST.
-- Headless means the rig adds nothing at the head slot: the real Head
-- is hidden with the rest of the body and nothing replaces it.
local FORM_MAP = {
	TorsoGlow       = "UpperTorso",
	DefinitiveWing  = "UpperTorso", -- Chapter 36: ONE double-sized angel wing (pink feathers, brown tips) welded at the back of the UpperTorso -- the wing IS the outfit; the morph wears no clothing assets
	Pelvis          = "LowerTorso",
	LeftUpperArm    = "LeftUpperArm",
	LeftLowerArm    = "LeftLowerArm",
	LeftHand        = "LeftHand",
	RightUpperArm   = "RightUpperArm",
	RightLowerArm   = "RightLowerArm",
	RightHand       = "RightHand",
	LeftUpperLeg    = "LeftUpperLeg",
	LeftLowerLeg    = "LeftLowerLeg",
	LeftFoot        = "LeftFoot",
	RightUpperLeg   = "RightUpperLeg",
	RightLowerLeg   = "RightLowerLeg",
	RightFoot       = "RightFoot",
}
-- Floating keepsakes: rig Part name -> body Part it hovers with.
-- These keep their OWN colour (the bow stays pink) and are the only
-- things at head height -- a bow floating over an empty neck is her
-- signature, and it is what other players will recognise her by.
local FLOATING_MAP = {
	SpiritBow = "Head",
}
-- Remote the client toggle (Script 9) fires. Created here if missing.
local toggleEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeSpiritToggle")
if not toggleEvent then
	toggleEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	toggleEvent.Name = "JadeSpiritToggle"
	toggleEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local saved = {} -- [character] = { [instance] = original Transparency }
local function remember(instance)
	local char = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not saved[char] then saved[char] = {} end
	if saved[char][instance] == nil then
		saved[char][instance] = instance.Transparency
	end
end
local function hideBody(character)
	-- Hide every visible body part -- Head included -- plus the face
	-- and accessories. The Parts and Motor6D joints stay in place;
	-- only the rendering goes. Animations, tools, and hats' anchor
	-- points are untouched, which is why nothing breaks.
	for _, inst in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			remember(inst)
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
			remember(inst)
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, acc in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
			local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				remember(handle)
				handle.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	end
end
local function showBody(character)
	local store = saved[character]
	if store then
		for inst, transparency in pairs(store) do
			if inst and inst.Parent then
				inst.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		saved[character] = nil
	end
end
local function clearSpiritForm(character)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("SpiritRig")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	character:SetAttribute("IsSpiritForm", false)
	character:SetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit", false)
end
local function weldTo(form, body, keepOwnColor)
	form.Anchored = false
	form.CanCollide = false
	form.CanTouch = false
	form.CanQuery = false
	form.Massless = true
	if not keepOwnColor then
		form.Color = SPIRIT_COLOR
		form.Material = SPIRIT_MATERIAL
	end
	form.CFrame = body.CFrame
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = body
	weld.Part1 = form
	weld.Parent = form
end
local function applySpiritForm(character)
	clearSpiritForm(character)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SpiritRig")
	if not template then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] SpiritRig not found in ServerStorage. Build it from Chapter 9, Step 2.")
		return
	end
	hideBody(character)
	local rig = template:Clone()
	rig.Name = "SpiritRig"
	rig.Parent = character
	-- Headless guarantee, enforced in code as well as in the build:
	-- if a Head part was ever left in the template rig, it is removed
	-- here and never reaches her character.
	local strayHead = rig:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
	if strayHead then strayHead:Destroy() end
	local welded = {} -- [form instance] = body Part it follows
	local templateCF = {} -- [form instance] = its template CFrame
	for formName, bodyName in pairs(FORM_MAP) do
		local form = rig:FindFirstChild(formName, true)
		local body = character:FindFirstChild(bodyName)
		if form and body and form:IsA("BasePart") then
			templateCF[form] = form.CFrame
			welded[form] = body
			weldTo(form, body, false)
		elseif form then
			form:Destroy()
		end
	end
	-- Floating keepsakes (the pink Spirit Bow): welded to the Head's
	-- body Part so the bow hovers and bobs with her movement, but the
	-- Head itself stays invisible -- bow visible, head not. That is
	-- the headless look.
	for partName, bodyName in pairs(FLOATING_MAP) do
		local part = rig:FindFirstChild(partName, true)
		local body = character:FindFirstChild(bodyName)
		if part and body and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			templateCF[part] = part.CFrame
			welded[part] = body
			-- Lift the bow above the empty neck joint.
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.85, 0)

			weld.Part0 = body
			weld.Part1 = part
			weld.Parent = part

		end
	end

	-- jade heart at the chest, glow studs along the arms): each
	-- keeps its own colour and offset and rides its form part.
	for _, detail in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if detail:IsA("BasePart") and not welded[detail] then
			local form = detail.Parent
			while form and not welded[form] do
				form = form.Parent
			end
			if form then
				local offset = templateCF[form]:ToObjectSpace(detail.CFrame)
				detail.Anchored = false
				detail.CanCollide = false
				detail.CanTouch = false
				detail.CanQuery = false
				detail.Massless = true
				detail.CFrame = welded[form].CFrame * offset
				local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				weld.Part0 = welded[form]
				weld.Part1 = detail
				weld.Parent = detail
			else
				detail:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	character:SetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit", true)
end
local function removeSpiritForm(character)
	clearSpiritForm(character)
	showBody(character)
end
local lastToggle = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of last accepted toggle
local function toggle(player)

	-- Xbox Y button, the shrine pad, and any script or exploit that
	-- fires this RemoteEvent directly -- arrives at this one function,
	-- and this function checks the UserId before it does anything.
	-- For everyone else it simply returns: no error, no message, no
	-- partial morph. There is nothing for them to unlock or buy.
	if not isExclusiveOwner(player) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastToggle[player] and now - lastToggle[player] < 1 then return end
	lastToggle[player] = now
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
		removeSpiritForm(character)
	else
		applySpiritForm(character)
	end
end
-- The (player) below is supplied by Roblox for the firing
-- connection. Any arguments an exploiter adds are ignored by design.
toggleEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	toggle(player)
end)
-- Optional shrine station: a Part named SpiritStation in Workspace

-- handler is the same locked toggle() above -- stepping up to the
-- shrine does nothing at all for anyone except the named owner.
local station = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpiritStation")
if station and station:IsA("BasePart") then
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Become the Jade Spirit"
	prompt.ObjectText = "A Family Keepsake"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = station
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		-- Prompts can be fired from across the map by modified
		-- clients, so reach is re-checked on the server (the UserId
		-- lock in toggle() then applies as usual).
		local character = player and player.Character
		local cRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not cRoot then return end
		if (cRoot.Position - station.Position).Magnitude
			> prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then return end

	end)
end
local function spawnArrivalEffect(character)
	-- Her entrance (Chapter 9): a breath of petals and a jade
	-- shimmer as the Guardian arrives. Pure theatre, server-made,
	-- the same for every witness -- other players are MEANT to
	-- see this. The legend walks in; she does not sneak in.
	local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

		petal.CanTouch = false
		petal.CanQuery = false

local function setupPlayer(player)

	-- itself -- toggle() above re-checks the UserId on every use,

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastToggle[player] = nil

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 10_Monetization.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Monetization
-- What it does: ALL paid content in the game, in one server Script --
-- Game Pass ownership checks on join, Game Pass purchase follow-up,
-- and Developer Product receipts (ProcessReceipt). Everything for
-- sale is cosmetic or convenience. Nothing here grants power.
--
-- ============================================================
-- THE ONE THING THAT IS NEVER FOR SALE
-- ============================================================
-- The Headless Jade Spirit form (Scripts 8 and 9) does not appear in
-- this file, in the shop Script 11, or anywhere in the shop at all.
-- It has no pass ID and no product ID, and no function in this file
-- can grant it. Do not add it here. It is unlocked only by the
-- UserId check in Script 8, for one named player, forever.
-- ============================================================
--
-- SECURITY MODEL (Chapter 14 has the full audit):
-- * A purchase prompt (Script 11) is a REQUEST, never a grant.
--   Passes take effect only after UserOwnsGamePassAsync -- Roblox's
--   own records -- says the player owns the pass. Products take
--   effect only inside ProcessReceipt, which Roblox calls on the
--   server after payment. A client cannot call either path itself.
-- * Every grant amount is a constant in the tables below. No client
--   input -- no RemoteEvent argument, no GUI field -- can name an
--   item, an amount, or a price. There is no code path to audit
--   beyond these two tables, and that is deliberate.
-- * Receipts are deduplicated against a persistent DataStore
--   ledger keyed by PurchaseId (see ProcessReceipt below), so a
--   redelivered receipt cannot grant twice -- in this session or
--   any later one.
-- * Grants refuse to run against an unloaded economy: if Script 1
--   flagged the player's data as not loaded, receipts answer
--   NotProcessedYet (Roblox redelivers later) instead of granting
--   into a balance that will never be saved.
--
-- SETUP (Chapter 6 walks through it click by click):
--   1. Create each Game Pass and Developer Product in the Creator
--      Dashboard (your game > Monetization). Creating them is free.
--   2. Copy each item's numeric ID into the two tables below.
--      An ID left at 0 means "not created yet" and that item is
--      disabled everywhere -- never prompted, never granted.
--   3. This Script must be the ONLY Script in the game that sets
--      MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt. Roblox allows exactly one
--      handler per game; a second one silently replaces the first.
--   4. ROUTED PRODUCTS: three catalogues live outside this file --
--      Colosseum tickets (Script 49's CONFIG), Vault skins (Script
--      51's SKINS), and the Sandbox Gate Pass (the PRODUCTS entry
--      below). Receipts for the first two are routed at grant time
--      to _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket / _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin, each
--      of which answers true only for its own IDs; an ID nobody
--      owns stays unknown and the receipt fails closed. Routing
--      happens inside the same six-step ledger discipline as every
--      other product -- routed grants are never granted twice.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
-- GAME PASSES: bought once, owned forever. Paste each ID from the
-- START HERE paste-point register; an ID of 0 disables that item.
local GAME_PASSES = {
	PetalTrailPack     = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsPetalTrailPack" },
	TwilightReaperPack      = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsTwilightReaperPack" },
	DaemonDesignPack        = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsDaemonDesignPack" },
	SakuraQueenSkin    = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsSakuraQueenSkin" },
	GoldenSpearSkin   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsGoldenSpearSkin" },
	BloomAuraEffects   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsBloomAuraEffects" },
	ExtraPetSlot       = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsExtraPetSlot" },
	GroveVIP           = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsGroveVIP" },
	SupporterSparkle   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsSupporterSparkle" },
	-- Thrust multipliers (Chapter 21): Script 13 verifies these
	-- itself at registration time; they are listed here so the shop
	-- and this table stay the game's single catalogue of passes.
	Multiplier2x       = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsMultiplier2x" },
	Multiplier3x       = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsMultiplier3x" },
	Multiplier5x       = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsMultiplier5x" },
	Multiplier10x      = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsMultiplier10x" },
}
-- DEVELOPER PRODUCTS: bought again and again (consumables).
-- There are deliberately NO Sakura Shard packs here. Shards are the
-- game's earn currency, and the free faucets (Scripts 3 and 4) pay
-- up to 4,500 Shards an hour each -- any shard pack small enough to
-- price for a child is worth minutes of ordinary play, and any pack
-- big enough to matter would let money stomp the earn economy flat.
-- Chapter 6 shows this arithmetic. What is sold instead cannot be
-- farmed: treats and fireworks exist only here.
local PRODUCTS = {
	PetTreatBundle  = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p) addItem(p, "PetTreats", 5) end },
	ShrineFirework  = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p) addItem(p, "Fireworks", 1) end },
	-- The Sandbox Gate Pass (Chapter 52): a one-time pass sold as a
	-- Developer Product at 80 Robux. The grant is consent-gated by
	-- design: if Script 56 holds no recorded acceptance of the
	-- current Sandbox Terms for this player, the grant errors, the
	-- receipt answers NotProcessedYet, and Roblox redelivers it --
	-- the pass can never land ahead of the consent it depends on.
	SandboxGatePass = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p)
		if not (_G.JadeSandboxHasConsent and _G.JadeSandboxHasConsent(p)) then
			error("Sandbox consent not recorded for this player")
		end
		if not (_G.JadeGrantSandboxAccess and _G.JadeGrantSandboxAccess(p)) then
			error("Sandbox grant unavailable (Script 56 not loaded)")
		end
	end },
}
-- Consumable bag: PetTreats / Fireworks counts live under the player
-- (never on the public leaderboard) AND in their own DataStore, so a
-- paid item survives rejoining. Loaded clamped, saved on every grant.
local bagStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_Bag_v1")
local function cleanCount(value)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if value == nil or value ~= value then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000)
end
local function getBag(player)
	local bag = player:FindFirstChild("MonetizationBag")
	if not bag then
		bag = Instance.new("Folder")
		bag.Name = "MonetizationBag"
		bag.Parent = player
		for _, name in ipairs({ "PetTreats", "Fireworks" }) do
			local item = Instance.new("IntValue")
			item.Name = name
			item.Value = 0
			item.Parent = bag
		end
	end
	return bag
end
local function saveBag(player)
	local bag = player:FindFirstChild("MonetizationBag")
	if not bag then return end
	pcall(function()
		bagStore:SetAsync("bag_" .. player.UserId, {
			PetTreats = cleanCount(bag.PetTreats.Value),
			Fireworks = cleanCount(bag.Fireworks.Value),
		})
	end)
end
local function loadBag(player)
	local bag = getBag(player)
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return bagStore:GetAsync("bag_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and type(data) == "table" then
		bag.PetTreats.Value = cleanCount(data.PetTreats)
		bag.Fireworks.Value = cleanCount(data.Fireworks)
	end
end
function addItem(player, name, amount)
	-- Declared as a global because the PRODUCTS table above closes
	-- over it. Amounts only ever come from that table's constants.
	local bag = getBag(player)
	local item = bag:FindFirstChild(name)
	if item then
		item.Value = cleanCount(item.Value + amount)
		saveBag(player)
	end
end
local function requestSave(player)
	-- Ask Script 1 to persist leaderstats now (it owns that store).
	local ev = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeRequestSave")
	if ev and ev:IsA("BindableEvent") then ev:Fire(player) end
end
local function findPassById(passId)
	for key, pass in pairs(GAME_PASSES) do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 and pass.Id == passId then return key, pass end
	end
	return nil, nil
end
local function findProductById(productId)
	for key, product in pairs(PRODUCTS) do
		if product.Id ~= 0 and product.Id == productId then return key, product end
	end
	return nil, nil
end
-- Cosmetic effect of owning each pass. Templates are OPTIONAL Models
-- in ServerStorage (a Trail, an Aura of particles). If a template is
-- not built yet, ownership is still recorded as an attribute -- the
-- skin / pet / lounge systems read those attributes, so passes work
-- before the art does, and adding the art later changes nothing here.
local function applyPassEffects(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsExtraPetSlot") then
		player:SetAttribute("MaxPetsOut", 3) -- default elsewhere is 1
	else
		player:SetAttribute("MaxPetsOut", 1)
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsPetalTrailPack")
		and not character:FindFirstChild("PetalTrailPackTrail") then
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("PetalTrailTemplate")
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		if template and template:IsA("Trail") and root and waist then
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", waist)
			local trail = template:Clone()
			trail.Name = "PetalTrailPackTrail"
			trail.Attachment0 = a0
			trail.Attachment1 = a1
			trail.Parent = character
		end
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsBloomAuraEffects")
		and not character:FindFirstChild("BloomAura") then
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("BloomAuraTemplate")
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if template and root then
			local aura = template:Clone()
			aura.Name = "BloomAura"
			aura.Parent = root
		end
	end
	-- SakuraQueenSkin, GoldenSpearSkin, GroveVIP, SupporterSparkle:
	-- presentation-only passes. Their systems check the attributes.
end
local refreshing = {} -- [player] = true while an ownership sweep runs
local function refreshPasses(player)
	if refreshing[player] then return end
	refreshing[player] = true
	for _, pass in pairs(GAME_PASSES) do
		local owns = false
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, pass.Id)
			end)
			owns = ok and result == true
			-- If the check itself failed (ok=false), keep whatever
			-- the attribute already said rather than stripping a
			-- paying player's pass over a transient API error.
			if not ok and player:GetAttribute(pass.Attribute) ~= nil then
				owns = player:GetAttribute(pass.Attribute) == true
			end
		end
		player:SetAttribute(pass.Attribute, owns)
	end
	refreshing[player] = nil
	applyPassEffects(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	loadBag(player)
	refreshPasses(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5) -- let GameManager hand over the spear first
		refreshPasses(player)
	end)
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(function()
		loadBag(player)
		refreshPasses(player)
	end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	refreshing[player] = nil
	saveBag(player)
end)
-- A pass bought while already in the game takes effect immediately.
-- The event alone is not trusted: the pass ID must be one of ours,
-- and ownership is re-verified against Roblox's records before the
-- attribute is set. A forged or replayed event grants nothing.
MarketplaceService.GamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, wasPurchased)
	if not wasPurchased then return end
	local _, pass = findPassById(passId)
	if not pass then return end
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, passId)
	end)
	if ok and owns then
		player:SetAttribute(pass.Attribute, true)
		applyPassEffects(player)
	end
end)
-- DEVELOPER PRODUCT RECEIPTS -- the money door, so it gets the most
-- locks. Roblox calls ProcessReceipt after payment, and may call it
-- AGAIN for the same purchase (the game closed mid-delivery, the
-- server died, an earlier call answered NotProcessedYet). Every
-- PurchaseId is therefore recorded in a persistent ledger:
--   1. In-session set hit        -> already granted: say Granted.
--   2. Ledger read fails         -> NotProcessedYet. Never grant
--      blind into a store you cannot record in.
--   3. Ledger already has the ID -> already granted in an earlier
--      session: say Granted, grant nothing.
--   4. Unknown / disabled product, wrong place, or the player's
--      economy has not loaded    -> NotProcessedYet.
--   5. Grant (constant amount from PRODUCTS, or a routed grant to
--      Script 49 / Script 51 for their own product IDs). Grant
--      fails -> NotProcessedYet, nothing recorded.
--   6. Record the PurchaseId, THEN answer PurchaseGranted. If the
--      record write fails, answer NotProcessedYet: Roblox will
--      redeliver, and step 1 or 3 will absorb the repeat. The one
--      residual window -- grant done, record lost, redelivery in a
--      LATER session reads an empty ledger -- is named in Chapter
--      14 rather than hidden; it is the known limit of check-then-
--      record on any platform, and redelivery is rare by design.
local receiptStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_Receipts_v1")
local processedThisSession = {} -- [PurchaseId] = true
MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if receiptInfo.PlaceIdWherePurchased ~= game.PlaceId then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("DataLoaded") ~= true then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local _, product = findProductById(receiptInfo.ProductId)
	-- A receipt whose ProductId is not in this file's own PRODUCTS
	-- table is NOT rejected here: it may belong to a routed
	-- catalogue (Script 49's tickets, Script 51's skins). Routing is
	-- decided at grant time, AFTER the ledger read below, so a
	-- redelivered routed receipt is absorbed by the ledger exactly
	-- like any other -- never granted twice.
	local readOk, prior = pcall(function()
		return receiptStore:GetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId)
	end)
	if not readOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if prior then
		processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	local grantOk, err = pcall(function()
		if product then
			product.Grant(player, receiptInfo.ProductId)
		else
			-- Routed products (Chapters 46, 47, 52): each grant
			-- answers true only for its own product IDs, so an ID
			-- nobody owns errors here and the receipt fails closed
			-- (NotProcessedYet) instead of granting on trust.
			local routed = (_G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket
				and _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)
				or (_G.JadeVaultGrantSkin
				and _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)
			if not routed then
				error("unknown ProductId " .. tostring(receiptInfo.ProductId))
			end
		end
	end)
	if not grantOk then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Product grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local writeOk = pcall(function()
		receiptStore:SetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId, {
			PlayerId = receiptInfo.PlayerId,
			ProductId = receiptInfo.ProductId,
		})
	end)
	if not writeOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
	requestSave(player)
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end
