				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 13_BlossomTree.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it BlossomTree
-- What it does: the Great Blossom Tree (Chapter 16) AND the game's
-- central thrust counter. The Tree stands at the centre of the Grove;
-- hitting it bursts petals and shimmers its crystals. Every
-- connecting spear thrust anywhere -- Tree, Thorn Husk, or Blossom
-- Arena opponent -- is reported here by Script 2 and counted ONCE,
-- under the PLAYER.
--
-- ============================================================
-- THE COUNT BELONGS TO THE PLAYER, NEVER THE WEAPON
-- ============================================================
-- * Personal counts are stored under "player_<UserId>" and global
--   totals under one shared key. Nothing anywhere is keyed by Tool,
--   skin, or variant: a player who swaps from the Wood spear to
--   the Golden skin mid-session keeps one continuous count, because
--   the counting function below receives a Player and a source --
--   it is never even told which weapon thrust.
-- * The equipped variant IS recorded, as cosmetic metadata in the
--   same record (WeaponVariant), because it is nice to know. It is
--   written on save from the player's SpearVariant attribute and
--   read by NOTHING that counts, ranks, pays, or unlocks.
-- * _G.JadeCountThrust is server-only (clients share no _G with the
--   server) and still re-validates: the source must be one of the
--   three real ones, the player must be alive and -- for Tree and
--   Arena sources -- genuinely standing where that source lives,
--   and counted thrusts are rate-capped per player. Script 2's
--   report is a claim; this function is the audit.
-- ============================================================
--
-- ============================================================
-- TWO COUNTS, TWO INDEPENDENT VALUES, BOTH THE PLAYER'S
-- ============================================================
-- * LIFETIME is the record: total connecting thrusts ever. It
--   only ever goes UP. It unlocks zones, sets ranks and titles,
--   grows the Susanoo, and feeds achievements. Nothing spends
--   it, nothing refunds it, nothing resets it.
-- * SPEND BALANCE is the wallet: a SEPARATE stored value. Each
--   counted thrust credits it by the same factor that credits
--   Lifetime, and bonus grants credit it alone -- but from that
--   moment the two values live apart. Spending (the Thrust Shop)
--   subtracts from Spend Balance ONLY.
-- * They are stored as two independent fields in the player's
--   record -- Spend Balance is NOT computed from Lifetime. Worked
--   example: a player at Lifetime 1,000 / Spend 1,000 buys a
--   300-thrust cosmetic. Spend becomes 700. Lifetime stays 1,000:
--   the zone gate that opened at 1,000 stays open, the rank the
--   1,000 earned stays earned. They land 10 more thrusts:
--   Lifetime 1,010, Spend 710. Two numbers, two jobs, no leakage.
-- * BOTH counts are pinned to the PLAYER (key "player_<UserId>").
--   Neither is tied to a weapon, a character, a Daemon pet, or
--   an appearance: swap spears, swap Daemons, rebuild a look at
--   the Workbench -- both counts follow the player, permanently.
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MIN_COUNT_INTERVAL = 0.35 -- per player, between counted thrusts
local TREE_RANGE = 16           -- HRP to TreeHitbox, in studs
local treeModel = workspace:WaitForChild("GreatBlossomTree", 15)

if hitbox then _G.JadeTreeHitbox = hitbox end

-- ---------- global total: batched, atomic, multi-server safe ------
local globalKnown = 0   -- last total confirmed by the DataStore
local globalPending = 0 -- thrusts counted here since that confirmation
local function displayTotal()
	return globalKnown + globalPending
end
local function nextMilestone()
	for _, m in ipairs(MILESTONES) do
		if displayTotal() < m.At then return m end
	end
	return nil
end
do -- initial load, retried: a failed read must not zero the world
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("global_total")
		end)
		if ok then
			globalKnown = tonumber(value) or 0
			break
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
-- ---------- personal records: one per UserId -----------------------
-- Schema (DataStore "JadeThrustEconomy_v2", key "player_<UserId>"):
--   { Lifetime     = <total connecting thrusts ever; ONLY rises;
--                     unlocks zones, ranks, titles, Susanoo stages>,
--     SpendBalance = <the wallet: an INDEPENDENT stored value,
--                     credited per counted thrust and by bonus
--                     grants; the only field spending subtracts>,
--     TreeHits = <of Lifetime, the hits that landed on the Tree>,
--     Witnessed = { ["100"] = true, ... } milestone celebrations,
--     Inventory = { SakuraSeed = 3, ... } shop goods,
--     WeaponVariant = "Wood" -- COSMETIC METADATA ONLY. Written for
--     the record, read by no counting, ranking, or reward code. }
-- Legacy records (Spent / Bonus fields, balance computed) are
-- migrated ONCE on load: SpendBalance starts at the old computed
-- balance, Lifetime is carried across untouched, and the legacy
-- fields are never written again.
local balanceOf -- forward declaration; defined with the economy APIs
local personal = {}   -- [player] = record table
local dirty = {}      -- [player] = true if record changed since save
local lastCounted = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of last counted thrust
local function loadPersonal(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			if type(data) == "table" then
				local function count(v)
					return math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0))
				end
				local lifetime = count(data.Lifetime)
				local spend = data.SpendBalance ~= nil and count(data.SpendBalance)
					or math.max(0, lifetime + count(data.Bonus) - count(data.Spent))
				return {
					Lifetime = lifetime,
					SpendBalance = spend,
					TreeHits = count(data.TreeHits),
					Witnessed = type(data.Witnessed) == "table" and data.Witnessed or {},
					Inventory = type(data.Inventory) == "table" and data.Inventory or {},
					Pets = type(data.Pets) == "table" and data.Pets or {},
					WeaponVariant = tostring(data.WeaponVariant or "Wood"),
				}
			end
			return { Lifetime = 0, SpendBalance = 0, TreeHits = 0,
				Witnessed = {}, Inventory = {}, Pets = {}, WeaponVariant = "Wood" }
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	return nil -- load failed: this session counts locally, saves never
end
local function savePersonal(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or player:GetAttribute("ThrustSaveDisabled") then return end
	record.WeaponVariant = player:GetAttribute("SpearVariant") or record.WeaponVariant
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, record)
	end)
	dirty[player] = nil
end
local function publishPersonal(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return end
	-- Server-set attributes other systems read: Script 15 ranks from
	-- ThrustTotal; Script 14 displays from the RemoteEvent below.
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustTotal", record.Lifetime)
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustBalance", balanceOf(record))
	player:SetAttribute("TreeHits", record.TreeHits)
	local folder = player:FindFirstChild("BlossomStats")
	if folder then
		folder.Lifetime.Value = record.Lifetime
		folder.Balance.Value = balanceOf(record)
		folder.TreeHits.Value = record.TreeHits
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Thrusts") then
		stats.Thrusts.Value = record.Lifetime
	end
	local nextM = nextMilestone()
	treeEvent:FireClient(player, displayTotal(), record.Thrusts,
		nextM and nextM.Name or "All milestones bloomed",
		nextM and nextM.At or displayTotal())
end

local shimmering = false

local function celebrate(milestone)

-- ---------- counting: the ONLY door thrusts enter through -----------
local VALID_SOURCES = { Tree = true, Husk = true, Arena = true }
local lastPairCount = {} -- ["attackerId:targetId"] = clock, arena anti-farm
-- ---------- thrust multipliers (Robux passes, Chapter 21) ------------
-- One-time Game Passes: while owned, each connecting thrust REGISTERS
-- as N thrusts toward BOTH of the player's counts: Lifetime and
-- the independent Spend Balance, credited side by side at this
-- single registration point. Design decisions, all deliberate:
-- * HIGHEST OWNED APPLIES. Factors never stack or multiply together:
--   owning 2x and 10x is 10x, not 20x. One number, auditable.
-- * The factor is applied HERE, at the single registration point,
--   by the server, from ownership re-verified against Roblox's own
--   records (UserOwnsGamePassAsync) -- never from a client value,
--   an attribute a client can influence, or Script 10's say-so.
-- * The GLOBAL Tree total counts raw physical thrusts (1 per thrust)
--   whatever the thruster's factor: communal milestones measure what
--   the world actually did, and the Tree sign stays literally true.
-- * Multipliers touch nothing else: not damage (Script 2 never reads
--   them), not zone gates directly (gates read Lifetime, which grows
--   faster -- disclosed in Chapters 20 and 21), and NEVER the
--   exclusive spirit form, which has no interaction with this system.
local MULTIPLIER_PASSES = { -- highest first
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 10 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 5 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 3 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 2 },
}
local multiplierCache = {} -- [player] = factor (server-verified)
local function refreshMultiplier(player)
	local factor = 1
	for _, pass in ipairs(MULTIPLIER_PASSES) do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, owns = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, pass.Id)
			end)
			if ok and owns then
				factor = pass.Factor
				break
			end
		end
	end
	multiplierCache[player] = factor
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustMultiplier", factor)
	return factor
end
function balanceOf(record)
	-- The wallet is its own stored value -- read directly, never
	-- derived from Lifetime. (Name kept: callers ask for a balance.)
	return record.SpendBalance
end
local function checkMilestones(before, after)
	for _, m in ipairs(MILESTONES) do
		if before < m.At and after >= m.At then
			celebrate(m)
			-- Witness reward: BONUS balance thrusts for everyone
			-- online -- credited to Balance only. It does not touch
			-- Lifetime, the global total, ranks, or titles: a gift
			-- is not a thrust, and this economy never pretends it is.
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local rec = personal[p]
				if rec and not rec.Witnessed[tostring(m.At)] then
					rec.Witnessed[tostring(m.At)] = true
					rec.SpendBalance += 25
					dirty[p] = true
					publishPersonal(p)
				end
			end
			refreshSign()
		end
	end
end
-- Script 2 calls this once per connecting thrust.
-- source: "Tree" | "Husk" | "Arena". targetPlayer: arena opponent.
function _G.JadeCountThrust(player, source, targetPlayer)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	if not VALID_SOURCES[source] then return end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCounted[player] and now - lastCounted[player] < MIN_COUNT_INTERVAL then
		return
	end
	if source == "Tree" then
		if not hitbox or (root.Position - hitbox.Position).Magnitude > TREE_RANGE then
			return -- claimed a Tree hit from somewhere else entirely
		end
	elseif source == "Arena" then
		-- Pair cap: trading hits with one partner counts at most
		-- once per second, however fast the two of you thrust.
		if typeof(targetPlayer) == "Instance" and targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
			local key = player.UserId .. ":" .. targetPlayer.UserId
			if lastPairCount[key] and now - lastPairCount[key] < 1 then return end
			lastPairCount[key] = now
		end
	end
	lastCounted[player] = now
	local before = displayTotal()
	local factor = multiplierCache[player] or 1
	record.Lifetime += factor
	record.SpendBalance += factor -- the wallet is credited too --
	-- independently: from here the two values live separate lives.
	if source == "Tree" then record.TreeHits += factor end
	dirty[player] = true
	globalPending += 1 -- raw thrusts only, whatever the factor (above)
	if source == "Tree" then treeReact(displayTotal() % 100 == 0) end
	checkMilestones(before, displayTotal())
	publishPersonal(player)
	refreshSign()
end
-- ---------- economy APIs: how thrusts leave and arrive --------------
-- Spending NEVER touches Lifetime: ranks, titles and milestones are
-- a record of what a player has done, and a record cannot be spent.
function _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, amount, _reason)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	amount = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
	if amount <= 0 then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or record.SpendBalance < amount then return false end
	record.SpendBalance -= amount -- the wallet, and ONLY the wallet
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end
function _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, amount, _reason)
	-- Bonus thrusts credit Balance only (quests, milestone witness
	-- gifts). Clamp keeps any future caller honest: no single grant
	-- may exceed 500, and bonuses never enter Lifetime or ranks.
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	amount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 500)
	if amount <= 0 then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return false end
	record.SpendBalance += amount
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end
function _G.JadeGrantItem(player, itemKey, count)
	-- Inventory lives inside the player's economy record, so a seed
	-- or a pet is saved by the same write that saves their thrusts.
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return false end
	count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0), -1000, 1000)
	record.Inventory[itemKey] = math.max(0, (record.Inventory[itemKey] or 0) + count)
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end
function _G.JadeGetLifetime(player)
	-- The zone gates' only key (Chapter 20). Lifetime is read from
	-- the record itself -- not from an attribute, not from Balance.
	local record = personal[player]
	return record and record.Lifetime or 0
end
function _G.JadeGetItem(player, itemKey)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return 0 end
	return record.Inventory[itemKey] or 0
end
-- Pet records (Chapter 23): pets are INDIVIDUALS, not counts, so
-- they live in their own table inside the same economy record and
-- are saved by the same write. Script 22 owns pet rules; this pair
-- of functions is the only door, and Set sanitises whatever it is
-- handed before it can reach the DataStore.
function _G.JadeGetPets(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return {} end
	local copy = {}
	for id, pet in pairs(record.Pets) do copy[id] = pet end
	return copy
end
function _G.JadeSetPets(player, pets)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or type(pets) ~= "table" then return false end
	local clean, count = {}, 0
	for id, pet in pairs(pets) do
		count += 1
		if count > 200 or type(id) ~= "string" or type(pet) ~= "table"
			or type(pet.Species) ~= "string" or #pet.Species > 40 then
			return false
		end
		clean[id] = {
			Species = pet.Species,
			Radiance = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pet.Radiance) or 0), 0, 2),
			Bond = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pet.Bond) or 0), 0, 1000000),
			Soulbound = pet.Soulbound == true,
		}
	end
	record.Pets = clean
	dirty[player] = true
	return true
end
function _G.JadeGetBalance(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	return record and balanceOf(record) or 0
end
-- ---------- persistence: batched global flush -----------------------
local function flushGlobal()
	if globalPending <= 0 then return end
	local delta = globalPending
	local ok, newTotal = pcall(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("global_total", function(old)
			return (tonumber(old) or 0) + delta
		end)
	end)
	if ok and tonumber(newTotal) then
		globalKnown = tonumber(newTotal)
		globalPending -= delta
		refreshSign()
	end
	-- On failure the pending thrusts stay pending and the next flush
	-- retries them: counted thrusts are never silently dropped, and
	-- UpdateAsync means two servers can never overwrite each other.
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(FLUSH_SECONDS)
		flushGlobal()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if dirty[p] then savePersonal(p) end
			publishPersonal(p) -- keeps displays honest across servers
		end
	end
end)

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

	end
end)

		folder.Parent = player
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Lifetime", "Balance", "TreeHits" }) do
			local v = Instance.new("IntValue")
			v.Name = name
			v.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	publishPersonal(player)
	refreshSign()
end

	multiplierCache[player] = nil
	personal[player] = nil
	dirty[player] = nil
	lastCounted[player] = nil
end)
refreshSign()

-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Leaderboard
-- What it does: the public thrust leaderboard (Chapter 18) -- an
-- in-world board by the Great Blossom Tree (top 10) and a UI feed of
-- the top 100, both ranked by LIFETIME thrusts from Script 13's

--

-- * The OrderedDataStore is written ONLY here, ONLY from Script 13's
--   server-side records (read via the ThrustTotal attribute Script 13
--   sets from its own DataStore-backed record). No client sends a
--   number: the UI's RemoteFunction takes no arguments and returns

-- * Writes are throttled: a player's entry is rewritten at most once
--   per REFRESH_SECONDS and only when their lifetime has grown, so
--   the board cannot be used to burn the DataStore budget.
-- * NOBODY is special-cased. There is no allowlist, boost, seed, or
--   family entry anywhere in this Script: the daughter's name
--   appears exactly when her own counted thrusts put it there, at
--   the rank those thrusts earn, under the same title ladder as
--   every other player. That is the design, stated in Chapter 18.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ranks = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("JadeThrustRanks_v1")
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60
local BOARD_ROWS = 10
local UI_ROWS = 100
local TITLES = { -- by lifetime thrusts; shared with Chapter 18
	{ At = 25000, Title = "Eternal Guardian" },
	{ At = 10000, Title = "Blossom Legend" },
	{ At = 5000,  Title = "Jade Master" },
	{ At = 2500,  Title = "Petal Storm" },
	{ At = 1000,  Title = "Blossom Knight" },
	{ At = 500,   Title = "Spear Dancer" },
	{ At = 250,   Title = "Bloom Keeper" },
	{ At = 100,   Title = "Petal Thruster" },
	{ At = 0,     Title = "Sprout" },
}
local function titleFor(thrusts)
	for _, t in ipairs(TITLES) do
		if thrusts >= t.At then return t.Title end
	end
	return "Sprout"
end
local nameCache = {} -- [userId] = display name
local function nameFor(userId)
	if nameCache[userId] then return nameCache[userId] end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	name = ok and name or ("Player " .. userId)
	nameCache[userId] = name
	return name
end
local boardCache = {} -- ranked rows: {UserId, Name, Thrusts, Title}
local cacheClock = 0
local function rebuildBoard()
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return ranks:GetSortedAsync(false, UI_ROWS)
	end)
	if not ok or not pages then return end
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
		local userId = tonumber(entry.key)
		local thrusts = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.value) or 0))
		if userId and thrusts > 0 then
			table.insert(rows, {
				UserId = userId,
				Name = nameFor(userId),
				Thrusts = thrusts,
				Title = titleFor(thrusts),
			})
		end
	end
	boardCache = rows
	cacheClock = os.clock()
end
-- ---------- in-world board -----------------------------------------
local boardLabel = nil
do
	local board = workspace:WaitForChild("LeaderboardBoard", 15)
	local face = board and board:FindFirstChild("BoardFace")
	if face and face:IsA("BasePart") then
		local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		gui.Parent = face
		boardLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		boardLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		boardLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 22, 28)
		boardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235)
		boardLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		boardLabel.TextScaled = true
		boardLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		boardLabel.Parent = gui
	end
end
local function refreshBoardDisplay()
	if not boardLabel then return end
	local lines = { "BLOSSOM THRUST LEADERBOARD" }
	for i = 1, math.min(BOARD_ROWS, #boardCache) do
		local r = boardCache[i]
		lines[#lines + 1] = i .. ". " .. r.Name .. " — " .. r.Thrusts .. " (" .. r.Title .. ")"
	end
	if #boardCache == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "No thrusts yet — be the first."
	end
	boardLabel.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
-- ---------- UI feed: read-only, argument-free, cached --------------
local fetchFunction = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeLeaderboardFetch")
if not fetchFunction then
	fetchFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	fetchFunction.Name = "JadeLeaderboardFetch"
	fetchFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
fetchFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(_player)
	-- The invoker's identity is irrelevant: everyone gets the same
	-- public table, and the cache caps how often it is rebuilt.
	if os.clock() - cacheClock > REFRESH_SECONDS then rebuildBoard() end
	return boardCache
end
-- ---------- keeping the store honest --------------------------------
local lastWritten = {} -- [userId] = lifetime last written to the store
local function writePlayer(player)
	local total = _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
	if total > 0 and total ~= lastWritten[player.UserId] then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			ranks:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), total)
		end)
		if ok then lastWritten[player.UserId] = total end
	end
end
task.spawn(function()
	rebuildBoard()
	refreshBoardDisplay()
	while true do
		task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do writePlayer(p) end
		rebuildBoard()
		refreshBoardDisplay()
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	writePlayer(player)
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do writePlayer(p) end
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 16_ArenaSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ArenaSystem
-- What it does: everything about the Blossom Arena EXCEPT the thrusts
-- themselves (Chapter 17). Script 2 decides whether a thrust lands --
-- including its rule that player targets only count inside the arena
-- cylinder. This Script owns: entry healing, spawn protection, KO
-- credit, arena respawn, and the session KO/fall tallies.
--
-- FAIR-PLAY INVARIANTS (they hold because of where code lives):
-- * Damage, range, cooldown, and knockback are constants in
--   Script 2. This Script cannot change them, the shop cannot sell
--   anything that changes them, and no attribute set by any
--   monetization Script is read by either. A Golden spear and a
--   Wood spear are the same weapon here; only the picture differs.
-- * KOs mint NOTHING. No thrusts (the thrusts that landed were
--   already counted by Script 13 when they connected), no currency,
--   no items. The tally below is a session scoreboard, not a bank.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ARENA_RADIUS = 55
local PROTECTION_SECONDS = 3
local function arenaCenter()
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	return center and center:IsA("BasePart") and center or nil
end
local function inArena(root)
	local center = arenaCenter()
	if not center or not root then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= ARENA_RADIUS
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end
local tallies = {} -- [player] = { KOs = n, Falls = n }
local function publish(player)
	local t = tallies[player]
	if not t then return end
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaKOs", t.KOs)
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaFalls", t.Falls)
end
local function watchCharacter(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	-- Entering the arena (teleported in by the gate pad, Script 6's
	-- destinations include Spawn_ArenaLobby; the bowl entry pad is
	-- below) starts every fight at full health with protection on.
	task.spawn(function()
		local wasIn = false
		while character.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			local isIn = inArena(root)
			if isIn and not wasIn then
				humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
				player:SetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil", os.clock() + PROTECTION_SECONDS)
			end
			player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", isIn)
			wasIn = isIn
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", false)
	end)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if not inArena(root) then return end
		local t = tallies[player]
		if t then
			t.Falls += 1
			publish(player)
		end
		-- KO credit: read the creator tag Script 2 stamped on this
		-- Humanoid with its last connecting thrust. It must name a
		-- DIFFERENT living player; anything else credits nobody.
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player
			and tallies[killer] then
			tallies[killer].KOs += 1
			publish(killer)
		end
		-- Respawn at the arena lobby, not the Grove: flag it, and
		-- the CharacterAdded path below moves the new character.
		player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", true)
	end)
end
local function setupPlayer(player)
	tallies[player] = { KOs = 0, Falls = 0 }
	publish(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		watchCharacter(player, character)
		if player:GetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby") then
			player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", false)
			local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_ArenaLobby")
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if lobby and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = lobby.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	tallies[player] = nil
end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 18_ThrustShop.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ThrustShop
-- What it does: the in-game shop, where the ONLY currency is thrusts
-- (Chapter 19). Item stands are Parts in the world named
-- "ThrustShop_<ItemKey>"; each gets a ProximityPrompt showing its
-- price in thrusts. Gardens: Parts "GardenPlot_1" .. "GardenPlot_4",
-- where seeds are planted, grow, and are harvested for bouquets.
--
-- HOW A PURCHASE WORKS (and why it cannot be cheated):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server (Script 6's
--   lesson), looks the price up in the server CATALOG below -- the
--   client names nothing but which stand it touched, and it does
--   not even do that: the handler is bound to the Part itself.
-- * Payment is Script 13's JadeSpendThrusts, which checks the
--   player's Balance (Lifetime + Bonus - Spent) and moves Spent.
--   Lifetime is never reduced, so buying can never cost a player a
--   rank, a title, a zone, or a milestone (Chapter 20).
-- * Unlock gates read Lifetime via JadeGetLifetime: some goods
--   cannot be bought before the player has DONE enough, however
--   rich their unspent balance is. Money (Robux) appears nowhere
--   in this Script; Robux passes live in Scripts 10/11 and sell
--   different, cosmetic-only goods.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CATALOG = {
	-- Pets are NOT sold here any more: Chapter 23 gives them eggs,
	-- events, merges, and one dedication grant instead. A pet with a
	-- price tag was the old design; this catalogue sells goods.
	-- Seeds (consumable -- the economy's repeat sink)
	SakuraSeed  = { Label = "Sakura Seed",            Price = 150,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	JadeMelonSeed = { Label = "Jade Melon Seed",      Price = 600,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	PearlSeed   = { Label = "Pearl Seed",             Price = 900,   Gate = 100000, Kind = "Seed" },
	MoonflowerSeed = { Label = "Moonflower Seed",     Price = 1800,  Gate = 50000,  Kind = "Seed" },
	StormSeed   = { Label = "Storm Seed",             Price = 4500,  Gate = 500000, Kind = "Seed" },
	EternalSeed = { Label = "Eternal Seed",           Price = 12000, Gate = 1000000, Kind = "Seed" },
	-- Cosmetics (own once)
	GroveTrail  = { Label = "Grove Trail",            Price = 500,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	PetalHat    = { Label = "Petal Hat",              Price = 800,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	SakuraScarf = { Label = "Sakura Scarf",           Price = 1200,  Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	BlossomWings = { Label = "Blossom Wings",         Price = 6000,  Gate = 2500,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	GoldenCrown = { Label = "Golden Crown",           Price = 15000, Gate = 5000,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	-- Consumables
	SpiritIncense = { Label = "Spirit Incense",       Price = 25,    Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
	BouquetBox  = { Label = "Bouquet Box (decor)",    Price = 300,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
}
-- Garden plots are sold by their own prompts below, not stands:
local PLOTS = { -- [plotNumber] = {Price, Gate}
	[2] = { Price = 2500, Gate = 500 },
	[3] = { Price = 6000, Gate = 2500 },
	[4] = { Price = 14000, Gate = 10000 },
}
local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end
local SEED_ORDER = { "EternalSeed", "StormSeed", "MoonflowerSeed", "HollowSeed", "PearlSeed", "JadeMelonSeed", "SakuraSeed" }
local SEED_COLORS = {
	SakuraSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
	JadeMelonSeed = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165),
	PearlSeed = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 235),
	MoonflowerSeed = Color3.fromRGB(170, 190, 255),
	HollowSeed = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190), -- Hollow drop only; never sold
	StormSeed = Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 255),
	EternalSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90),
}
local GROW_SECONDS = 300
local function ownedCount(player, key)
	return _G.JadeGetItem and _G.JadeGetItem(player, key) or 0
end
-- ---------- item stands ---------------------------------------------
for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and string.sub(part.Name, 1, 10) == "ThrustShop_" then
		local key = string.sub(part.Name, 11)
		local item = CATALOG[key]
		if item then
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ActionText = "Buy — " .. item.Price .. " thrusts"
			prompt.ObjectText = item.Label
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
			prompt.Parent = part
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if not near(player, part, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
				if (_G.JadeGetLifetime(player)) < item.Gate then return end
				if item.Kind == "Cosmetic"
					and ownedCount(player, key) >= 1 then
					return -- own-once goods are never charged for twice
				end
				if _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, item.Price, key) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, key, 1)
				end
				-- A failed spend (balance short) does nothing at all:
				-- no partial charge, no debt, no item.
			end)
		end
	end
end
-- ---------- garden plots ---------------------------------------------
local plotState = {} -- [part] = { Owner, SeedKey, ReadyAt, Flower }
local function clearFlower(part)
	local st = plotState[part]
	if st and st.Flower then st.Flower:Destroy() end
	plotState[part] = nil
end
local function growFlower(part, seedKey, owner)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "GardenFlower"
	local stem = Instance.new("Part")
	stem.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 3, 0.3)
	stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 80)
	stem.Anchored = true
	stem.CanCollide = false
	stem.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	stem.Parent = model
	local bloom = Instance.new("Part")
	bloom.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bloom.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	bloom.Color = SEED_COLORS[seedKey] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203)
	bloom.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	bloom.Anchored = true
	bloom.CanCollide = false
	bloom.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	bloom.Parent = model
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
for i = 1, 4 do
	local plot = workspace:FindFirstChild("GardenPlot_" .. i)
	if plot and plot:IsA("BasePart") then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Use Garden Plot"
		prompt.ObjectText = "Garden Plot " .. i
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.Parent = plot
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if not near(player, plot, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
			local st = plotState[plot]
			if st then
				-- Occupied: only the planter harvests, only when ripe.
				if st.Owner == player and os.clock() >= st.ReadyAt then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "Bouquet", 1)
					clearFlower(plot)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Empty: plots 2-4 must be bought first (once, forever).
			if i > 1 and ownedCount(player, "GardenPlot" .. i) < 1 then
				local spec = PLOTS[i]
				if _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) >= spec.Gate
					and _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, spec.Price, "GardenPlot" .. i) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "GardenPlot" .. i, 1)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Plant the best seed the player is carrying.
			for _, seedKey in ipairs(SEED_ORDER) do
				if ownedCount(player, seedKey) >= 1 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, seedKey, -1)
					plotState[plot] = {
						Owner = player,
						SeedKey = seedKey,
						ReadyAt = os.clock() + GROW_SECONDS,
						Flower = growFlower(plot, seedKey, player),
					}
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for part, st in pairs(plotState) do
		if st.Owner == player then clearFlower(part) end
	end
end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 19_ZoneGates.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ZoneGates
-- What it does: the world ladder (Chapter 20). Each gated zone is
-- reached ONLY through its gate pad -- Parts named "ZoneGate_<Key>"
-- beside a decorative gateway (torii, portal ring, moon gate) --
-- because the zones themselves are separate islands with no walk-in
-- path. A gate opens for a player whose LIFETIME thrusts meet the
-- threshold, and teleports them to "Spawn_<Key>".
--
-- THE ONE RULE THAT MAKES THIS FAIR:
-- * Gates read Lifetime, through Script 13's JadeGetLifetime, and
--   nothing else. This Script contains no reference to Balance,
--   Spent, or Bonus -- spending every thrust you own cannot re-lock
--   a single gate, and a rich balance cannot open one early.
-- * The check is recomputed on the server at every crossing attempt
--   from the economy record itself. Gate visuals (Script 20) are
--   client decoration: a gate that LOOKS open to a tampered client
--   still teleports nobody the record says is short.
-- * Zone defence in depth: a slow monitor also checks gated-zone
--   regions. A player found inside a zone their Lifetime does not
--   unlock -- flown, flung, or glitched there -- is returned to the
--   Grove. Access is a server fact, not a doorway.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GATES = { -- order matters: the ladder, low to high
	{ Key = "SkyCanopy",    Name = "Sky Canopy",          Required = 1000,    GateKind = "Cloud Torii" },
	{ Key = "CrystalDeep",  Name = "Crystal Deep",        Required = 10000,   GateKind = "Crystal Portal" },
	{ Key = "HollowGrove",  Name = "The Hollow Grove",    Required = 25000,   GateKind = "Thorn Gate" },
	{ Key = "MoonlitForest", Name = "Moonlit Bamboo Forest", Required = 50000, GateKind = "Moon Torii" },
	{ Key = "KoiGrotto",    Name = "Sunken Koi Grotto",   Required = 100000,  GateKind = "Waterfall Portal" },
	{ Key = "Stormspire",   Name = "Stormspire Peaks",    Required = 500000,  GateKind = "Storm Arch" },
	{ Key = "Sanctum",      Name = "Eternal Blossom Sanctum", Required = 1000000, GateKind = "Golden Portal" },
}
local ZONE_RADIUS = 130
local deniedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneDenied")
if not deniedEvent then
	deniedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	deniedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneDenied"
	deniedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local unlockedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneUnlocked")
if not unlockedEvent then
	unlockedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	unlockedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneUnlocked"
	unlockedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function lifetimeOf(player)
	return _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
end
local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, nil end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance, root
end
for _, gate in ipairs(GATES) do
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneGate_" .. gate.Key)
	local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_" .. gate.Key)
	if pad and spawn then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Enter — " .. gate.Required .. " lifetime thrusts"
		prompt.ObjectText = gate.Name .. " (" .. gate.GateKind .. ")"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
		prompt.Parent = pad
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			local ok, root = near(player, pad, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4)
			if not ok or not root then return end
			local have = lifetimeOf(player)
			if have >= gate.Required then
				root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			else
				deniedEvent:FireClient(player, gate.Name, gate.Required, have)
			end
		end)
	end
end
-- Unlock celebrations + region defence.
local announced = {} -- [player] = { [gateKey] = true }

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ThrustTotal"):Connect(function()

				unlockedEvent:FireClient(player, gate.Name, gate.Required)

end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(watchPlayer, player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) announced[player] = nil end)
task.spawn(function()

				end
			end

end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 29_HollowGrove.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it HollowGrove
-- What it does: the Hollow Grove (Chapter 25) -- a corrupted island
-- where Thorn Skeletons rise in waves and experienced Keepers farm
-- them. Unlock: 25,000 lifetime thrusts, through Script 19's gate.
-- Skeletons that escape the Hollow are also the corruption that
-- assaults the Great Blossom Tree itself (Script 13 runs those
-- events); this zone is where the corruption lives.
--
-- RISK AND REWARD, IN THE OPEN:
-- * A skeleton laid to rest pays its killer BONUS thrusts (Balance only) --
--   the fastest balance faucet in the game, priced in Chapter 25.
--   It pays the killer named by Script 2's creator tag, once, from
--   this Script. Kills never touch Lifetime: the thrusts that landed
--   were already counted when they connected. Farming here fills a
--   wallet; it cannot forge a history.
-- * Skeletons HURT: their strike is real damage, waves scale, and a
--   fall restarts your wave progress in spirit if not in code --
--   you respawn at the lobby and run back in while the wave you
--   left keeps coming. High risk, high reward, no death tax:
--   nothing is taken from a player who falls. Ever.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ZONE_CENTER = workspace:WaitForChild("ZoneCenter_HollowGrove", 15)
local ZONE_RADIUS = 130
local TEMPLATE_NAME = "ThornSkeletonTemplate"
local INTERMISSION = 15
local MAX_ALIVE = 24
local wave = 0
local alive = {} -- [model] = { Humanoid, Root, LastBite }
local waveActive = false
local zoneOccupied = false
local function inZone(root)
	if not ZONE_CENTER or not root then return false end
	return (root.Position - ZONE_CENTER.Position).Magnitude <= ZONE_RADIUS
end
local function playersInZone()
	local list = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and inZone(root) then table.insert(list, p) end
	end
	return list
end
local function killReward(waveNumber)
	return 6 + waveNumber -- bonus thrusts to the killer
end
local function isBossWave(n)
	return n % 5 == 0
end
local function spawnSkeleton(waveNumber, boss)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_NAME)
	if not template then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] ThornSkeletonTemplate missing in ServerStorage (Chapter 25, build steps).")
		return nil
	end
	local skel = template:Clone()
	skel.Name = "HollowSkeleton"
	local humanoid = skel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = skel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root then skel:Destroy() return nil end
	local hp = (boss and 400 or 50) + 25 * (waveNumber - 1) * (boss and 2 or 1)
	humanoid.MaxHealth = hp
	humanoid.Health = hp
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = boss and 11 or 9 + math.min(5, waveNumber * 0.3)
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsThornHusk", true) -- Script 2 can hit it
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsHollowSkeleton", true)
	if boss then skel:ScaleTo(1.6) end
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	local dist = math.random(30, 70)
	skel.Parent = workspace
	skel:MoveTo(ZONE_CENTER.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, 3, math.sin(angle) * dist))
	alive[skel] = { Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root, LastBite = 0, Boss = boss }
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		local entry = alive[skel]
		alive[skel] = nil
		-- Pay the killer Script 2's tag names, re-validated.
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer.Parent then
			_G.JadeGrantBonus(killer, killReward(wave), "SkeletonKill")
			if _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence then
				_G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence(killer, entry and entry.Boss and 15 or 2, "SkeletonKill")
			end
			-- Exclusive drops (Chapter 25): the Hollow provides.
			local roll = math.random()
			if entry and entry.Boss then
				_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowSeed", 1)
				if roll < 0.12 and _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence then
					_G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence(killer, 25, "BossDrop")
				elseif roll < 0.37 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "BoneBow", 1)
				end
			else
				if roll < 0.04 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowSeed", 1)
				elseif roll < 0.05 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowCharm", 1)
				end
			end
		end
		-- Burst of dark petals: corruption coming apart.
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local petal = Instance.new("Part")
			petal.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			petal.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.14, 0.5)
			petal.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 110)
			petal.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			petal.CanCollide = false
			petal.CanTouch = false
			petal.CanQuery = false
			petal.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			petal.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), math.random(5, 11), math.random(-6, 6))
			petal.Parent = workspace
			Debris:AddItem(petal, 1.2)
		end
		task.delay(0.3, function() skel:Destroy() end)
	end)
	return skel
end
-- ---------- wave director ---------------------------------------------
local function aliveCount()
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(alive) do n += 1 end
	return n
end
local function startWave()
	wave += 1
	waveActive = true
	local count = math.min(4 + wave * 2, MAX_ALIVE)
	for i = 1, count do
		task.delay(i * 0.7, function()
			if zoneOccupied then spawnSkeleton(wave, false) end
		end)
	end
	if isBossWave(wave) then
		task.delay(3, function()
			if zoneOccupied then spawnSkeleton(wave, true) end
		end)
	end
end
local function waveClearedBonus()
	-- Everyone standing in the Hollow when a wave falls shares its
	-- bonus: the farm rewards the group that held the ground.
	if wave % 5 == 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(playersInZone()) do
			_G.JadeGrantBonus(p, 100, "WaveCleared")
		end
	end
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local occupants = playersInZone()
		zoneOccupied = #occupants > 0
		if not zoneOccupied then
			if waveActive or aliveCount() > 0 then
				for skel in pairs(alive) do skel:Destroy() end
				alive = {}
				wave = 0
				waveActive = false
			end
			continue
		end
		if not waveActive then
			task.wait(INTERMISSION)
			if #playersInZone() > 0 then startWave() end
		elseif aliveCount() == 0 then
			waveClearedBonus()
			waveActive = false
			task.wait(INTERMISSION)
			if #playersInZone() > 0 then startWave() end
		end
		-- Skeleton behaviour: shamble at the nearest Keeper; bite on
		-- contact with a per-skel cooldown. All server-run.
		local now = os.clock()
		for skel, entry in pairs(alive) do
			local humanoid, root = entry.Humanoid, entry.Root
			if humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local best, bestDist, bestRoot = nil, math.huge, nil
				for _, p in ipairs(occupants) do
					local pRoot = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local pHum = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 then
						local d = (pRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist then best, bestDist, bestRoot = pHum, d, pRoot end
					end
				end
				if bestRoot then
					humanoid:MoveTo(bestRoot.Position)
					if bestDist <= 4 and now - entry.LastBite >= 1 then
						entry.LastBite = now
						best:TakeDamage(entry.Boss and 14 or 8)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
-- The Tree-assault system (Script 13) reuses this template through
-- the same ServerStorage name; nothing else here is shared.
]]></ProtectedString>

-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Statue
-- What it does: the Guardian Statue by the Great Blossom Tree
-- (Chapter 27) -- its plaque, its crystal flame, and its dignity.
-- The statue is a MONUMENT: visible to every player, a landmark, a

-- 8's UserId lock and to nothing else -- a statue of a guardian is

					light.Enabled = false

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 31_DefenseSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it DefenseSystem
-- What it does: THE DEFENSE OF THE THREE (Chapter 26). The village,
-- the Great Blossom Tree, and the Guardian Statue share one fate and
-- one system: three global meters -- Village, Tree, Statue -- kept
-- in a DataStore, published as workspace attributes, drained by
-- corruption assaults, healed by Keepers' thrusts, and defended
-- together. Every other system reads the attributes; only this
-- Script moves the meters.
--
-- THE GUARDIAN WALKS AMONG THEM: while the exclusive owner's
-- account is in the server (the SAME UserId pasted in Script 8 --
-- paste it below too), defenses are stronger in three concrete,
-- code-visible ways: assault drains run at 60% speed, assault
-- skeletons spawn with 80% health, and the lowest meter quietly
-- regenerates. This is the lore made mechanical. It changes no
-- damage number any player deals, sells nothing, and cannot be
-- transferred: her presence is the buff, and presence cannot be
-- botted by anyone who is not her.
--
-- Kid-safe stakes: a meter at zero is FALLEN, never destroyed. The
-- village closes its shops and hides, the Tree withers to Critical,
-- the Statue's flame goes out -- and all three heal back over time
-- and with thrusts. Nothing the corruption does is permanent.
-- Permanence is the players' side of the story.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with the same UserId as Script 8
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeDefense_v1")
local METER_MAX = 1000
local SAVE_SECONDS = 30
local ASSAULT_INTERVAL = 1200 -- 20 minutes between assaults
local ASSAULT_LENGTH = 240
local METERS = { "Village", "Tree", "Statue" }
local health = { Village = METER_MAX, Tree = METER_MAX, Statue = METER_MAX }
local loaded = false
local defenseEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeDefenseEvent")
if not defenseEvent then
	defenseEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	defenseEvent.Name = "JadeDefenseEvent"
	defenseEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function guardianPresent()
	if EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID == 0 then return false end
	return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID) ~= nil
end
local function publish()
	for _, m in ipairs(METERS) do
		workspace:SetAttribute(m .. "Health", math.floor(health[m]))
		workspace:SetAttribute(m .. "Fallen", health[m] <= 0)
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute("GuardianPresent", guardianPresent())
	workspace:SetAttribute("ThreatLevel", workspace:GetAttribute("ThreatLevel") or 0)
end
-- Loading: retried, fail-quiet. A failed load starts the meters full
-- for the session and disables saving (Script 1's doctrine: a bad
-- read must never become a bad write over the world's real state).
for _ = 1, 3 do
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("meters_v1")
	end)
	if ok then
		loaded = true
		if type(data) == "table" then
			for _, m in ipairs(METERS) do
				health[m] = math.clamp(tonumber(data[m]) or METER_MAX, 0, METER_MAX)
			end
		end
		break
	end
	task.wait(1)
end
local function saveMeters()
	if not loaded then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("meters_v1", health)
	end)
end
function _G.JadeHealMeter(meter, amount)
	if not health[meter] then return end
	amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 50)
	health[meter] = math.clamp(health[meter] + amount, 0, METER_MAX)
	publish()
end
function _G.JadeDamageMeter(meter, amount)
	if not health[meter] then return end
	amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 50)
	health[meter] = math.clamp(health[meter] - amount, 0, METER_MAX)
	publish()
end
function _G.JadeGetMeter(meter)
	return health[meter] or 0
end
-- ---------- village NPCs: the threat, made visible --------------------
local npcs = {}
for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if model:IsA("Model") and string.sub(model.Name, 1, 11) == "VillageNPC_" then
		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if head and root then
			local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 44)
			gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
			gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 34, 30)
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 225)
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			label.TextSize = 14
			label.Parent = gui
			gui.Parent = head
			table.insert(npcs, {
				Model = model, Label = label, Root = root,
				Home = root.CFrame,
				Name = string.sub(model.Name, 12),
			})
		end
	end
end
local NPC_LINES = {
	Calm = { "The Tree is safe. We thrust on.", "Lovely blossoms today.", "Mind the petals, Keeper." },
	Alarmed = { "Did you hear that? Bones...", "Stay near the gates!", "The corruption is close." },
	Shelter = { "Inside! Inside!", "Guard the door, Keepers!", "The Guardian will come..." },
}
local function setThreat(level)
	workspace:SetAttribute("ThreatLevel", level)
	for _, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
		if level >= 2 then
			local shelter = workspace:FindFirstChild("VillageShelter")
			if shelter then npc.Model:MoveTo(shelter.Position) end
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Shelter
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		elseif level == 1 then
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Alarmed
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		else
			npc.Model:MoveTo(npc.Home.Position)
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Calm
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		end
	end
	publish()
end
-- ---------- assaults -----------------------------------------------------
local TARGETS = {
	Village = { Anchor = "VillageHeart", Drain = 3, ZoneRadius = 90, Display = "the Village" },
	Tree = { Anchor = "TreeHitbox", Parent = "GreatBlossomTree", Drain = 4, ZoneRadius = 60, Display = "the Great Blossom Tree" },
	Statue = { Anchor = "StatueBase", Drain = 3, ZoneRadius = 60, Display = "the Guardian Statue" },
}
local assaultIndex = 0
local assaultActive = false
local function anchorFor(targetKey)
	local spec = TARGETS[targetKey]
	if spec.Parent then
		local parent = workspace:FindFirstChild(spec.Parent)
		return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(spec.Anchor)
	end
	return workspace:FindFirstChild(spec.Anchor)
end
local function spawnAssaultSkeleton(anchor, guardian)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ThornSkeletonTemplate")
	if not template then return nil end
	local skel = template:Clone()
	skel.Name = "AssaultSkeleton"
	local humanoid = skel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	skel.Parent = workspace

local function runAssault(targetKey)
	if assaultActive then return end
	local spec = TARGETS[targetKey]
	local anchor = anchorFor(targetKey)
	if not anchor then return end
	assaultActive = true
	local guardian = guardianPresent()
	local startHealth = health[targetKey]
	setThreat(2)
	defenseEvent:FireAllClients("AssaultStarted", spec.Display, guardian)
	local skels = {}
	local toSpawn = 8
	local spawned = 0
	local deadline = os.clock() + ASSAULT_LENGTH
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(1)
		-- trickle spawns to the cap
		local aliveNow = 0
		for _, z in ipairs(skels) do
			if z.Humanoid.Health > 0 then aliveNow += 1 end
		end
		if spawned < toSpawn and aliveNow < 6 then
			local z = spawnAssaultSkeleton(anchor, guardian)
			if z then table.insert(skels, z) spawned += 1 end
		end
		-- skels march on the target and chew it
		local draining = 0
		for _, z in ipairs(skels) do
			if z.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local d = (z.Root.Position - anchor.Position).Magnitude
				if d > 9 then
					z.Humanoid:MoveTo(anchor.Position)
				else
					draining += 1
				end
			end
		end
		if draining > 0 then
			local rate = spec.Drain * math.min(draining, 5) * (guardian and 0.6 or 1)
			_G.JadeDamageMeter(targetKey, rate) -- per second tick
		end
		local allDead = spawned >= toSpawn
		for _, z in ipairs(skels) do
			if z.Humanoid.Health > 0 then allDead = false break end
		end
		if allDead then break end
		if health[targetKey] <= 0 then break end
	end
	-- survivors crumble; the event is judged by what it cost
	for _, z in ipairs(skels) do
		if z.Humanoid.Health > 0 then z.Model:Destroy() end
	end
	local lost = startHealth - health[targetKey]
	local repelled = lost < 400 and health[targetKey] > 0
	defenseEvent:FireAllClients(repelled and "AssaultRepelled" or "AssaultWithered", spec.Display, guardian)
	if repelled then
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

			local root = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				_G.JadeGrantBonus(p, 75, "DefenseAtPost") -- 150 total at post
			end
		end
	end

	assaultActive = false

local function recordInvalid(player, reason)
	local now = os.clock()
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	if not entry or now - entry.windowStart > 60 then
		entry = { count = 0, windowStart = now, lockedUntil = 0, lastLog = 0 }
		invalidLog[player.UserId] = entry
	end
	entry.count = entry.count + 1
	if entry.count >= 3 then entry.lockedUntil = now + 60 end
	if now - entry.lastLog >= 5 then
		entry.lastLog = now
		warn(string.format("[JadeCreator] Rejected config from %s (UserId %d): %s (strike %d)",
			player.Name, player.UserId, reason, entry.count))
	end
end
local function validateConfig(player, raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "payload is not a table" end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 1 profile (8 fields, no mask
	-- fields) is upgraded with the starter mask, then validated
	-- exactly like a native v2 payload. A CLIENT payload claiming
	-- Version 1 with mask fields, or any other field mix, fails.
	if raw.Version == 1 then
		local v1Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v1Count = v1Count + 1
			if not V1_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v1 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v1Count ~= 8 then return nil, "v1 field count is not exactly 8" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(maskDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		-- v1 named the weapon slot "Scythe"; the current schema
		-- calls it "Spear" (the Twin Spear redesign, Chapter 4).
		-- Same palette ID, new field name -- the value carries
		-- over untouched.
		merged.Spear = merged.Scythe
		merged.Scythe = nil
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 2 profile (13 fields, masks but
	-- no weapon/wing design) gains the design defaults the same
	-- way -- the unified flow must never orphan an older profile.
	if raw.Version == 2 then
		local v2Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v2Count = v2Count + 1
			if not V2_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v2 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v2Count ~= 13 then return nil, "v2 field count is not exactly 13" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 3 profile (19 fields, no Daemon
	-- choices) gains the Daemon defaults the same way.
	if raw.Version == 3 then
		local v3Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v3Count = v3Count + 1
			if not V3_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v3 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v3Count ~= 19 then return nil, "v3 field count is not exactly 19" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(daemonDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 4
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 4 profile (25 fields, no
	-- DaemonForm) gains the solid-form default the same way.
	if raw.Version == 4 then
		local v4Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v4Count = v4Count + 1
			if not V4_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v4 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v4Count ~= 25 then return nil, "v4 field count is not exactly 25" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.DaemonForm = "FormSolid"
		merged.Version = 5
		raw = merged
	end
	local keyCount = 0
	for key in pairs(raw) do
		keyCount = keyCount + 1
		if not CONFIG_KEYS[key] then
			return nil, "unapproved field present: " .. tostring(key)
		end
	end
	if keyCount ~= 26 then return nil, "field count is not exactly 26" end
	if raw.Version ~= 5 then return nil, "Version is not 5" end
	if type(raw.Chassis) ~= "string" or not CHASSIS[raw.Chassis] then
		return nil, "Chassis is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Material) ~= "string" or not MATERIALS[raw.Material] then
		return nil, "Material is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Detail) ~= "number" or not DETAIL_STOPS[raw.Detail] then
		return nil, "Detail is not an approved stop"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "Spear", "Aura", "Effects" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " colour is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.Lighting) ~= "string" or not LIGHTING[raw.Lighting] then
		return nil, "Lighting is not an approved preview"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskShape) ~= "string" or not MASK_SHAPES[raw.MaskShape] then
		return nil, "MaskShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMaterial) ~= "string" or not MASK_MATERIALS[raw.MaskMaterial] then
		return nil, "MaskMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.MaskColor] then
		return nil, "MaskColor is not in the palette"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskGlow) ~= "string" or not MASK_GLOWS[raw.MaskGlow] then
		return nil, "MaskGlow is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMotif) ~= "string" or not MASK_MOTIFS[raw.MaskMotif] then
		return nil, "MaskMotif is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponStyle) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_STYLES[raw.WeaponStyle] then
		return nil, "WeaponStyle is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponMaterial) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_MATERIALS[raw.WeaponMaterial] then
		return nil, "WeaponMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingCount) ~= "number" or not WING_COUNTS[raw.WingCount] then
		return nil, "WingCount is not 0, 1, or 2"
	end
	if type(raw.WingShape) ~= "string" or not WING_SHAPES[raw.WingShape] then
		return nil, "WingShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingMaterial) ~= "string" or not WING_MATERIALS[raw.WingMaterial] then
		return nil, "WingMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.WingColor] then
		return nil, "WingColor is not in the palette"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "DaemonColor", "DaemonGlow", "DaemonClaw" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonMaterial) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_MATERIALS[raw.DaemonMaterial] then
		return nil, "DaemonMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonScale) ~= "number" or not DAEMON_SCALES[raw.DaemonScale] then
		return nil, "DaemonScale is not an approved scale"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonAccessory) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_ACCESSORIES[raw.DaemonAccessory] then
		return nil, "DaemonAccessory is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonForm) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_FORMS[raw.DaemonForm] then
		return nil, "DaemonForm is not on the whitelist"
	end
	-- The skeleton form is a STANDARD skeleton-bear variant: it
	-- passes this gate for any account that owns the Daemon
	-- Design Package (OwnsDaemonDesignPack). It is NOT Oakley's
	-- pet -- her Daemon is the Gold Dragon (Script 39, GoldDragon),
	-- which no Workbench field can name or grant.
	if raw.DaemonForm == "FormSkeleton" and player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") ~= true then
		return nil, "DaemonForm FormSkeleton requires the Daemon Design Package"
	end
	-- Rebuilt from catalogue constants, never the client's table:
	-- even a passing payload contributes nothing but its choices.
	return { Version = 5, Chassis = raw.Chassis, Material = raw.Material,
		Detail = raw.Detail, Spear = raw.Spear, Aura = raw.Aura,
		Effects = raw.Effects, Lighting = raw.Lighting,
		MaskShape = raw.MaskShape, MaskMaterial = raw.MaskMaterial,
		MaskColor = raw.MaskColor, MaskGlow = raw.MaskGlow, MaskMotif = raw.MaskMotif,
		WeaponStyle = raw.WeaponStyle, WeaponMaterial = raw.WeaponMaterial,
		WingCount = raw.WingCount, WingShape = raw.WingShape,
		WingMaterial = raw.WingMaterial, WingColor = raw.WingColor,
		DaemonColor = raw.DaemonColor, DaemonMaterial = raw.DaemonMaterial,
		DaemonScale = raw.DaemonScale, DaemonGlow = raw.DaemonGlow,
		DaemonClaw = raw.DaemonClaw, DaemonAccessory = raw.DaemonAccessory,
		DaemonForm = raw.DaemonForm }
end
local function isLockedOut(player)
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	return entry and os.clock() < entry.lockedUntil or false
end
-- ---------- persistence: sanitised profiles only ---------------------
local function saveProfile(player)
	if not loadOk[player.UserId] then return end
	local config = profiles[player.UserId]
	if config == nil then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, config or false)
	end)
end
local function loadProfile(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			loadOk[player.UserId] = true
			if data == nil or data == false then
				profiles[player.UserId] = data or false
				return
			end
			local clean, reason = validateConfig(player, data)
			if clean then
				profiles[player.UserId] = clean
			else
				-- Stored data failing today's whitelist is treated
				-- as no profile and never re-saved over itself.
				profiles[player.UserId] = false
				loadOk[player.UserId] = false
				recordInvalid(player, "stored profile rejected: " .. reason)
			end
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	profiles[player.UserId] = false
end
-- ---------- building the look (server-side parts only) ---------------
local function clearCreatorLook(character)
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 12) == "JadeCreator_" then child:Destroy() end
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		local emitter = root:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_Effect")
		if emitter then emitter:Destroy() end
	end
end
local function setScales(humanoid, scales)
	local fields = { Height = "HeightScale", Width = "WidthScale", Depth = "DepthScale",
		Head = "HeadScale", BodyType = "BodyTypeScale", Proportion = "ProportionScale" }
	for key, childName in pairs(fields) do
		local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(childName)
		if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") then value.Value = scales[key] end
	end
end
local function makePart(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end
local function weldTo(part, target, offset)
	part.CFrame = target.CFrame * offset
	part.Parent = target.Parent
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = part
	weld.Part1 = target
	weld.Parent = part
end
local function makeWedge(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end
-- ---------- the Mask Atelier build (server-side parts only) ----------
-- One source of truth for mask colours: the builder paints from
-- this function and the sweep repairs from this function, so a
-- tampered mask part is repainted to exactly these values.
local function maskRoleColor(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" then
		if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then return paletteColor(config.MaskColor) end
		return paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(mat.Color[1], mat.Color[2], mat.Color[3])
end
local function maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" and config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		return Enum.Material.Neon
	end
	return Enum.Material[mat.Material]
end
-- The exact set of mask parts a config should produce:
-- [part name] = expected Color3. The sweep compares against this.
local function expectedMaskParts(config)
	local expected = {}
	if config.MaskShape == "None" then return expected end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		expected["JadeCreator_Mask" .. entry[1]] = maskRoleColor(entry[4], config)
	end
	local motif = MASK_MOTIFS[config.MaskMotif]
	for i = 1, motif.Count do
		local color = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i] = color
	end
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeL"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeR"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return expected
end
local function buildMask(character, config)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head or config.MaskShape == "None" then return end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		local suffix, size, offset, role, kind = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3], entry[4], entry[5]
		local color = maskRoleColor(role, config)
		local material = maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
		local part
		if kind == "Wedge" then
			part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		else
			part = makePart("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		end
		if role == "main" then part.Transparency = mat.Transparency end
		weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3]))
	end
	-- Motif attachments, welded to the head over the mask plate.
	local motifOffsets = {
		MotifSpiral = { { 0, 0.42, -0.70 } },
		MotifBlossom = { { 0, 0.48, -0.68 }, { -0.17, 0.36, -0.68 }, { 0.17, 0.36, -0.68 },
			{ -0.10, 0.60, -0.68 }, { 0.10, 0.60, -0.68 } },
		MotifFang = { { -0.28, -0.68, -0.60 }, { 0.28, -0.68, -0.60 } },
	}
	local offsets = motifOffsets[config.MaskMotif]
	if offsets then
		local motifColor = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor) or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		local motifMaterial = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material[MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial].Material]
		for i, off in ipairs(offsets) do
			local part
			if config.MaskMotif == "MotifFang" then
				part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.16, 0.34, 0.16), motifColor, motifMaterial)
			elseif config.MaskMotif == "MotifSpiral" then
				part = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.52, 0.52, 0.08), motifColor, motifMaterial)
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			else
				part = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.20, 0.20, 0.10), motifColor, motifMaterial)
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			end
			weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(off[1], off[2], off[3]))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing eyes: two neon lenses on the mask's eye line.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ { "L", -0.30 }, { "R", 0.30 } }) do
			local eye = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskEye" .. side[1],
				Vector3.new(0.24, 0.12, 0.06), paletteColor(config.MaskColor), Enum.Material.Neon)
			weldTo(eye, head, CFrame.new(side[2], 0.14, -0.68))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing etchings: one soft light inside the main plate.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		local plate = character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskPlate")
			or character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskLowerPlate")
		if plate then
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Name = "JadeCreator_MaskGlowLight"
			light.Color = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			light.Brightness = 1
			light.Range = 6
			light.Parent = plate
		end
	end
end
local function paintSpear(player, config)
	local containers = {}
	local character = player.Character
	if character then table.insert(containers, character) end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then table.insert(containers, backpack) end
	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		local tool = container:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if tool then
			for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "Tip" then
					-- Only the crystal spear Tip takes the palette.
					-- The wood Shaft, gold GoldBands, and dark Handle
					-- are the twins' fixed design and never repainted.
					part.Color = config and paletteColor(config.Spear) or TIP_DEFAULT
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
local function applyConfig(player, config)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
		-- Her form is Script 8's territory. The creator neither
		-- modifies it nor builds on top of it -- ever.
		clearCreatorLook(character)
		return false
	end
	applying[player.UserId] = true
	clearCreatorLook(character)
