-- this Script reads them and builds the spectral version. The
-- twins' designs are FIXED and ignore attributes entirely: hers
-- is the jade spear with ONE pink crystal wing; his is the
-- violet spear with ONE violet crystal wing and purple jade
-- growths wired through the form (see buildRig).
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Script 8)
local WEAPON_STYLE_FACTORS = {
	SpearClassic = { Tip = 1.0, Shaft = 1.0, Wide = 1.0 },
	SpearLong = { Tip = 1.3, Shaft = 1.15, Wide = 0.9 },
	SpearBroad = { Tip = 0.9, Shaft = 0.95, Wide = 1.45 },
}
local WEAPON_MAT_COLORS = {
	WDarkwood = Color3.fromRGB(74, 50, 38), WEbony = Color3.fromRGB(38, 32, 40),
	WPalewood = Color3.fromRGB(226, 218, 200), WGoldleaf = Color3.fromRGB(217, 164, 65),
	WBamboo = Color3.fromRGB(146, 184, 96),
}
local WING_MAT_COLORS = {
	WPinkCrystal = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203), WJade = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165),
	WViolet = Color3.fromRGB(150, 100, 255), WGold = Color3.fromRGB(217, 164, 65),
	WObsidian = Color3.fromRGB(60, 55, 80),
}
local function resolveDesign(player)
	if TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID then
		-- Her fixed design: darkwood shaft, JADE crystal tip
		-- (Color paints the tip), ONE pink crystal wing.
		return { Style = "SpearClassic", Mat = WEAPON_MAT_COLORS.WDarkwood,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165), WingCount = 1, WingShape = "Crystal",
			WingColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203), WingMat = WING_MAT_COLORS.WPinkCrystal }
	end
	if alignmentOf(player) == "Violet" then
		return { Style = "SpearClassic", Mat = WEAPON_MAT_COLORS.WDarkwood,
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(165, 90, 255), WingCount = 1, WingShape = "Crystal",
			WingColor = Color3.fromRGB(165, 90, 255), WingMat = WING_MAT_COLORS.WViolet }
	end
	local wingCount = player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingCount")
	return {
		Style = player:GetAttribute("CreatorWeaponStyle") or "SpearClassic",
		Mat = WEAPON_MAT_COLORS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorWeaponMaterial") or ""] or WEAPON_MAT_COLORS.WDarkwood,
		Color = PALETTE_COLORS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorSpear") or ""] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
		WingCount = typeof(wingCount) == "number" and wingCount or 1,
		WingShape = player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingShape") or "Crystal",
		WingColor = PALETTE_COLORS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor") or ""] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
		WingMat = WING_MAT_COLORS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingMaterial") or ""]
			or PALETTE_COLORS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor") or ""] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
	}
end
-- ---------- the rig: server-built spectral parts ----------------------
local function addPart(parts, name, size, offset, color, transparency, material, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Transparency = transparency
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	if shape then part.Shape = shape end
	table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Offset = offset })
	return part
end
local function buildRig(player)
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	destroyRig(player)
	if not record or record.Stage == 0 or not record.Manifested then return end
	local stage = record.Stage
	local colors = resolveColors(player)
	local design = resolveDesign(player)
	local s = stage >= 5 and 1.45 or stage >= 4 and 1.25 or 1
	local P, E, A, T = colors.Primary, colors.Energy, colors.Accent, colors.BodyTransparency
	local parts = {}
	local function V(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x * s, y * s, z * s) end
	local function C(x, y, z, rx, ry, rz)
		return CFrame.new(V(x, y, z)) * CFrame.Angles(rx or 0, ry or 0, rz or 0)
	end
	-- Stage 1+: the frame of arcs around its Keeper.
	addPart(parts, "Spine", V(0.7, 5.4, 0.7), C(0, 2.2, 1.3), P, T)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local y = 3.6 - (i - 1) * 0.55
		addPart(parts, "ArcL" .. i, V(2.6 - i * 0.22, 0.34, 0.34), C(-0.95, y, 0.95, 0, 0, -0.35), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArcR" .. i, V(2.6 - i * 0.22, 0.34, 0.34), C(0.95, y, 0.95, 0, 0, 0.35), P, T)
	end
	local core = addPart(parts, "Core", V(1.15, 1.15, 1.15), C(0, 2.7, 1.0), E, 0.12, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	if alignmentOf(player) == "Violet" or stage >= 4 then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = E
		light.Range = 16
		light.Brightness = 1.4
		light.Parent = core
	end
	if stage >= 2 then
		addPart(parts, "ArmLU", V(0.6, 2.8, 0.6), C(-2.1, 3.3, 0.7, 0, 0, 0.45), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmRU", V(0.6, 2.8, 0.6), C(2.1, 3.3, 0.7, 0, 0, -0.45), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmLF", V(0.55, 2.4, 0.55), C(-2.9, 1.9, 0.4, 0, 0, 0.85), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmRF", V(0.55, 2.4, 0.55), C(2.9, 1.9, 0.4, 0, 0, -0.85), P, T)
		-- The guardian's spectral Twin Spear: one long wood
		-- shaft and a great pointed crystal tip -- the player's
		-- own weapon, scaled to the guardian (Chapter 30).
		local styleF = WEAPON_STYLE_FACTORS[design.Style] or WEAPON_STYLE_FACTORS.SpearClassic
		local reveal = ({ [2] = 0.5, [3] = 0.8, [4] = 1.0, [5] = 1.25 })[stage] or 1
		addPart(parts, "SpearShaft", V(0.26, 5.4 * styleF.Shaft, 0.26), C(3.7, 2.4, -0.5, 0.35, 0, 0), design.Mat, T)
		addPart(parts, "SpearGuard", V(1.15, 0.22, 1.15), C(3.55, 4.6, -1.15), design.Color, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "SpearTip", V(0.5 * styleF.Wide, 2.6 * reveal * styleF.Tip, 0.5 * styleF.Wide), C(3.45, 5.6, -1.9, -0.5, 0, 0), design.Color, 0.1)
	end
	if stage >= 3 then
		addPart(parts, "Pelvis", V(2.3, 0.8, 0.95), C(0, 0.1, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "LegL", V(0.72, 2.8, 0.72), C(-0.8, -1.5, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "LegR", V(0.72, 2.8, 0.72), C(0.8, -1.5, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "PauldronL", V(1.1, 0.6, 1.1), C(-1.6, 4.15, 0.9), A, T)
		addPart(parts, "PauldronR", V(1.1, 0.6, 1.1), C(1.6, 4.15, 0.9), A, T)
		addPart(parts, "Head", V(1.5, 1.6, 1.5), C(0, 5.6, 1.05), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "HornL", V(0.28, 1.3, 0.28), C(-0.55, 6.7, 1.05, 0, 0, 0.35), E, 0.15)
		addPart(parts, "HornR", V(0.28, 1.3, 0.28), C(0.55, 6.7, 1.05, 0, 0, -0.35), E, 0.15)
	end
	if alignmentOf(player) == "Violet" and stage >= 3 then
		-- Purple jade wired through the shadow form: crystal
		-- growths at the shoulders and forearms, a glowing vein
		-- across the chest -- the same growths that run through
		-- his armor and his body (Chapter 5). His design is not
		-- decorated with crystal; it is grown through with it.
		addPart(parts, "JadeGrowthL", V(0.55, 1.5, 0.55), C(-1.7, 4.6, 0.9, 0, 0, 0.4), E, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "JadeGrowthR", V(0.55, 1.5, 0.55), C(1.7, 4.6, 0.9, 0, 0, -0.4), E, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "JadeGrowthArmL", V(0.4, 1.1, 0.4), C(-2.95, 2.1, 0.4, 0, 0, 0.85), E, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "JadeGrowthArmR", V(0.4, 1.1, 0.4), C(2.95, 2.1, 0.4, 0, 0, -0.85), E, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "JadeVein", V(2.3, 0.2, 0.2), C(0, 3.2, 0.35, 0, 0, 0.25), E, 0.05)
	end
	if stage >= 4 then
		addPart(parts, "Chestplate", V(3.0, 2.2, 0.5), C(0, 3.1, 0.45), P, math.max(0.05, T - 0.13))
		addPart(parts, "Crest", V(1.4, 0.5, 0.3), C(0, 6.6, 0.6), A, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "SkirtL", V(1.0, 1.2, 0.4), C(-0.9, -0.5, 0.8), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "SkirtR", V(1.0, 1.2, 0.4), C(0.9, -0.5, 0.8), P, T)
	end
	-- Designed wings, revealed as the guardian grows: a hint at
	-- Stage 3, full span at Stage 4, massive at Stage 5. Count and
	-- shape are the player's workbench design (twins: fixed at 1).
	if stage >= 3 and design.WingCount > 0 then
		local wingScale = ({ [3] = 0.6, [4] = 1.0, [5] = 1.5 })[stage] or 1
		local sides = design.WingCount >= 2 and { -1, 1 } or { -1 }
		for _, sideSign in ipairs(sides) do
			local sideName = sideSign < 0 and "L" or "R"
			if design.WingShape == "Blade" then
				addPart(parts, "Wing" .. sideName .. "1", V(0.2, 4.2 * wingScale, 1.1),
					C(sideSign * 2.7, 4.0, 2.2, 0, sideSign * -0.4, sideSign * 0.6), design.WingMat, 0.2)
			elseif design.WingShape == "Feather" then
				for i = 1, 3 do
					addPart(parts, "Wing" .. sideName .. i, V(0.22, (3.4 - i * 0.6) * wingScale, 1.5 - i * 0.25),
						C(sideSign * (2.3 + i * 0.35), 4.1 - i * 0.35, 2.2, 0, sideSign * -0.4, sideSign * (0.45 + i * 0.12)), design.WingMat, 0.2)
				end
			else -- Crystal: three fanned shards, like the twins' wings
				for i = 1, 3 do
					addPart(parts, "Wing" .. sideName .. i, V(0.28, (3.6 - i * 0.7) * wingScale, 0.95 - i * 0.15),
						C(sideSign * (2.4 + i * 0.4), 4.0 - i * 0.3, 2.2, 0, sideSign * -0.4, sideSign * (0.4 + i * 0.18)), design.WingMat, 0.15)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if stage >= 5 then
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Texture = "rbxassetid://241594419"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(E)
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
		emitter.Rate = 26
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		emitter.Parent = core
	end
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "JadeSusanoo_" .. player.UserId
	for _, entry in ipairs(parts) do entry.Part.Parent = model end
	model.Parent = workspace
	rigs[player.UserId] = { Model = model, Parts = parts, Player = player }
	player:SetAttribute("SusanooAlignment", alignmentOf(player))
	player:SetAttribute("SusanooStage", stage)
end
function destroyRig(player)
	local rig = rigs[player.UserId]
	if rig then rig.Model:Destroy() rigs[player.UserId] = nil end
end
-- ---------- presence: the guardian stands with its Keeper -------------
local function inArena(root)
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	if not center or not center:IsA("BasePart") or not root then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= 55
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		for userId, rig in pairs(rigs) do
			local character = rig.Player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root then
				local base = CFrame.new(root.Position, root.Position + root.CFrame.LookVector)
					* CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.2)
				for _, entry in ipairs(rig.Parts) do
					entry.Part.CFrame = base * entry.Offset
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
-- ---------- combat gifts: corruption only, never Keepers --------------
local absorbing = {}
local lastHealth = {}
local function hookShield(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	lastHealth[player.UserId] = humanoid.Health
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
		local previous = lastHealth[player.UserId] or newHealth
		lastHealth[player.UserId] = newHealth
		if absorbing[player.UserId] then return end
		local record = data[player.UserId]
		if not record or record.Stage == 0 or not record.Manifested then return end
		if newHealth >= previous or newHealth <= 0 then return end
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if inArena(root) then return end -- the guardian will not fight Keepers
		local shield = shields[player.UserId] or 0
		if shield <= 0 then return end
		local absorbed = math.min(shield, previous - newHealth)
		shields[player.UserId] = shield - absorbed
		absorbing[player.UserId] = true
		humanoid.Health = newHealth + absorbed
		lastHealth[player.UserId] = humanoid.Health
		absorbing[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(2)
		for userId, record in pairs(data) do
			local maxShield = SHIELD_MAX[record.Stage]
			if record.Manifested and (shields[userId] or 0) < maxShield then
				shields[userId] = math.min(maxShield, (shields[userId] or 0) + 5)
			end
		end
	end
end)
function _G.JadeSusanooBonusDamage(player)
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record or not record.Manifested then return 0 end
	local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if inArena(root) then return 0 end
	return BONUS_DAMAGE[record.Stage] or 0
end
function _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence(player, amount, _source)
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record then return end
	amount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 50)
	if amount <= 0 then return end
	record.Essence = record.Essence + amount
	record.EssenceTotal = record.EssenceTotal + amount
	dirty[player.UserId] = true
end
-- ---------- progression: stages are derived, never declared ----------
local function eligibleStage(lifetime, essenceTotal)
	local stage = 0
	for i, spec in ipairs(STAGES) do
		if lifetime >= spec.Lifetime and essenceTotal >= spec.Essence then
			stage = i - 1
		end
	end
	return stage
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(5)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local record = data[player.UserId]
			if record and loadOk[player.UserId] then
				local lifetime = _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
				local reached = eligibleStage(lifetime, record.EssenceTotal)
				if reached > record.Stage then
					record.Stage = reached
					shields[player.UserId] = SHIELD_MAX[reached]
					dirty[player.UserId] = true
					savePlayer(player)
					buildRig(player)
					susanooEvent:FireAllClients("StageUp", player.Name, reached, alignmentOf(player))
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)
-- ---------- remotes & lifecycle ----------------------------------------
susanooFetch.OnServerInvoke = function(player)
	local record = data[player.UserId] or defaultData()
	local nxt = STAGES[record.Stage + 2] -- next stage's spec, if any
	return {
		Stage = record.Stage,
		StageName = STAGES[record.Stage + 1].Name,
		Alignment = alignmentOf(player),
		Essence = record.Essence,
		EssenceTotal = record.EssenceTotal,
		Shield = math.floor(shields[player.UserId] or 0),
		ShieldMax = SHIELD_MAX[record.Stage],
		Manifested = record.Manifested,
		NextLifetime = nxt and nxt.Lifetime or nil,
		NextEssence = nxt and nxt.Essence or nil,
	}
end
-- ---------- the condensed form (Chapter 32, Script 39) -------------
-- For the TWINS only, the Susanoo has two states of one being:
-- EXPANDED (this Script's spectral rig) and CONDENSED (the crystal
-- bear spirit form Script 39 builds). Script 39 is the only caller.
-- Condensed suppresses the rig and the shield alike -- the bear's
-- body takes the hits a spectral form would have absorbed, and it
-- has its own (physical) presence instead. Non-twins are refused:
-- their Susanoo has one state, spectral, as Chapter 30 describes.
local function isTwin(player)
	return (TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID)
		or (TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID)
end
function _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, form)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	if not isTwin(player) then return false end
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.Stage < 2 then return false end
	if form == "Condensed" then
		record.Manifested = false
		destroyRig(player)
		player:SetAttribute("SusanooForm", "Condensed")
	elseif form == "Expanded" then
		record.Manifested = true
		buildRig(player)
		player:SetAttribute("SusanooForm", "Expanded")
	else
		return false
	end
	dirty[player.UserId] = true
	return true
end
local lastToggle = {}
toggleEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastToggle[player.UserId] and now - lastToggle[player.UserId] < 1 then return end
	lastToggle[player.UserId] = now
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.Stage == 0 then return end
	-- While a twin's form is CONDENSED (Chapter 32), the bear is
	-- the manifestation: the plain toggle must not raise a second
	-- spectral body alongside it. Script 39 owns form changes.
	if player:GetAttribute("SusanooForm") == "Condensed" then return end
	record.Manifested = not record.Manifested
	dirty[player.UserId] = true
	if record.Manifested then buildRig(player) else destroyRig(player) end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	loadPlayer(player)
	player:SetAttribute("SusanooAlignment", alignmentOf(player))

		task.delay(1.5, function()
			local record = data[player.UserId]
			if record and record.Manifested and record.Stage > 0 then buildRig(player) end
		end)
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CreatorMaterial"):Connect(function()
		local record = data[player.UserId]
		if record and record.Manifested and record.Stage > 0 then buildRig(player) end
	end)
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CreatorAura"):Connect(function()
		local record = data[player.UserId]
		if record and record.Manifested and record.Stage > 0 then buildRig(player) end
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	savePlayer(player)
	destroyRig(player)
	data[player.UserId] = nil
	shields[player.UserId] = nil
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do savePlayer(player) end
end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(30)
		for userId in pairs(dirty) do
			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if player then savePlayer(player) end
		end
	end
end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 37_KimonoSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename KimonoSystem
-- KIMONO-FIRST (Chapter 31): the kimono is the BASE look of
-- this game -- every player spawns wearing one. Two base styles
-- are always owned and never sold: GrovePurple (deep purple
-- robe, white trim -- his default palette) and GroveWhite
-- (white robe, purple trim -- hers). Battle armor is an
-- equipable LAYER worn over the kimono (Script 33's creator
-- pieces and the Armor toggle), never the base. Two premium
-- Game Pass variants -- Blossom (cherry blossom pink, jade
-- trim) and Violet (deep violet, silver trim) -- are sold as
-- pure cosmetics. Worn only in non-combat areas; the Arena
-- warden equips the armor layer automatically.
--
-- THE RULES THIS SCRIPT ENFORCES ON THE SERVER:
-- * Ownership is a Roblox fact, never a client claim: passes are
--   checked with UserOwnsGamePassAsync on join and re-checked at
--   every toggle. A pass ID left at 0 disables that style.
-- * A kimono is casual wear. It cannot be worn inside the
--   Blossom Arena (the same geometric check Script 2 uses), it
--   stows the Twin Spear in the Backpack while worn, and a
--   2-second warden reverts any wearer who walks into the Arena
--   still dressed for the village.
-- * Her spirit form form owns her character completely: while
--   IsJadeSpirit is set, this Script builds nothing on her.
-- * The kimono is built from server constants (the STYLES table)
--   as parts named JadeKimono_*. The client sends a style ID and
--   nothing else -- no colours, no parts, no asset IDs.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
-- Paste the two Game Pass IDs from the Creator Dashboard
-- (Chapter 31, setup steps). 0 = that style stays disabled.
local PASSES = {
	Blossom = 0, -- << Blossom Kimono pass ID
	Violet = 0,  -- << Violet Kimono pass ID
}
-- Base kimonos: no pass exists for these and none ever will --
-- ownership is constant true, granted by this table alone.
local BASE_STYLES = { GrovePurple = true, GroveWhite = true }
local STYLES = {
	GrovePurple = {
		Label = "Grove Kimono — Purple",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(78, 52, 160),    -- deep purple
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),  -- white accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),   -- white sash
	},
	GroveWhite = {
		Label = "Grove Kimono — White",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(240, 238, 242),  -- white
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 200),   -- purple accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(78, 52, 160),     -- deep purple sash
	},

-- ---------- combo-to-move: the Daemon Stride ---------------------------
-- Alternating weapon thrusts and Daemon swipes does not only
-- fight -- it MOVES. Link 2 (and every even link): STRIDE DASH, a
-- forward burst. Link 3 (and every multiple of 3): WING LAUNCH,
-- an upward burst. Mounted, the bursts move the coupled unit
-- (Daemon + rider as one); on foot they move the player, with
-- the Daemon answering beside them. One burst per link number.
local function strideBurst(player, st, kind)
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
	local root
	if mounted then
		root = st.Bear and st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		local char = player.Character
		root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	if not root then return end
	local facing = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local velocity = flat.Unit * (kind == "Launch" and 10 or 34)
		+ Vector3.new(0, kind == "Launch" and 30 or 4, 0)
	if mounted and kind == "Dash" then velocity *= 1.3 end -- coupled momentum
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = root
	local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	lv.Attachment0 = att
	lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	lv.VectorVelocity = velocity
	lv.MaxForce = 200000
	lv.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(lv, 0.22)
	Debris:AddItem(att, 0.25)
end
-- ---------- Daemon combat: the claw answers the thrust ----------------
local function tagCreator(huskHumanoid, player)
	local tag = huskHumanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if not tag then
		tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Parent = huskHumanoid
	end
	tag.Value = player
	Debris:AddItem(tag, 5)
end
local function bearSwipe(player, st)
	local bear = st.Bear
	if not bear or st.Form ~= "Bear" then return end
	local root = bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local stats = statsFor(player)
	local best, bestDist = nil, 9
	for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Humanoid") and enemy:GetAttribute("IsThornHusk") and enemy.Health > 0 then
			local eRoot = enemy.Parent and enemy.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if eRoot then
				local d = (eRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = enemy, d end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return end
	-- the chain: a landing swipe inside the window extends it
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastThrust or 0) <= MOUNT_WINDOW then
		st.Chain = (st.Chain or 0) + 1
		if st.Chain ~= st.LastStrideLink then
			st.LastStrideLink = st.Chain
			if st.Chain % 3 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Launch")
			elseif st.Chain % 2 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Dash") end
		end
		if st.Chain % 5 == 0 and st.Chain ~= st.LastBonusChain then
			st.LastBonusChain = st.Chain
			if _G.JadeGrantBonus then _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, 5, "MountChain") end
		end
	else
		st.Chain = 1
	end
	tagCreator(best, player)
	best:TakeDamage(stats.Claw)
	pushUpdate(player)
end
-- Called by Script 2 on EVERY connecting thrust (any player; this
-- function itself decides whether a Daemon answers).
function _G.JadeDaemonThrust(player, stage)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if st then
		-- RESONANCE (the partnership sync): every connecting thrust
		-- raises keeper-Daemon sync by 8, capped at 100, decaying
		-- 6 per second. It builds in ANY form -- keeper and Daemon
		-- acting together is the bond -- and is spent only in
		-- Weapon form, by _G.JadeDaemonSurge below.
		local nowR = os.clock()
		local r = st.Resonance or 0
		if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowR - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
		st.Resonance = math.min(100, r + 8)
		st.ResonanceT = nowR
	end
	if not st or st.Form ~= "Bear" or not st.Bear then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local bearRoot = st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not bearRoot then return end
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
		and st.RiderSeat.Occupant.Parent == char
	if not mounted and (root.Position - bearRoot.Position).Magnitude > COMBO_NEAR then return end
	st.LastThrust = os.clock()
	if mounted then
		-- COUPLING: rider and Daemon are one unit. The Daemon's
		-- momentum amplifies every thrust (a forward surge that
		-- grows with the thrust stage), and a held turn while
		-- thrusting carves the unit around -- thrust-steering:
		-- the weapon's direction, amplified by the body.
		local facing = bearRoot.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)

-- ---------- the WEAPON form: the Daemon IS the spear --------------
-- The keeper's weapon and pet are one being. From BEAR form, with

local savedTipColor = {}
local function paintWeapon(player, on)
	local char = player.Character
	local spear = (char and char:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear"))
		or player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") and player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
	if not spear then return end
	local tip = spear:FindFirstChild("Tip")
	if not tip then return end
	if on then
		savedTipColor[player.UserId] = tip.Color
		local glow = CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonGlow")]
			or CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonColor")]
			or Color3.fromRGB(185, 140, 255)
		tip.Color = glow
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Name = "DaemonLight"
		light.Color = glow
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = tip
	else
		local light = tip:FindFirstChild("DaemonLight")
		if light then light:Destroy() end
		if savedTipColor[player.UserId] then
			tip.Color = savedTipColor[player.UserId]
			savedTipColor[player.UserId] = nil
		end
	end
end
local function foldToWeapon(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]

	st.Fly, st.Flying = false, false
	st.Chain = 0
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Weapon")
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonWeaponForm", true)
	-- FOLD-IN, reversed: the bear's elements draw together and pour
	-- into the spear's tip over TRANSFORM_SECONDS, claws last.
	task.spawn(function()
		local order = ELEMENT_ORDER
		for i = #order, 1, -1 do
			local part = bear:FindFirstChild(order[i])
			if part then part.Transparency = 0.45 end
			task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#order + 4))
		end

	paintWeapon(player, true)
	pushUpdate(player)
end
local function unfoldFromWeapon(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]

	player:SetAttribute("DaemonWeaponForm", nil)
	st.Form = "Susanoo"

-- Called by Script 2 before it damages a husk. At full sync in
-- WEAPON form, the Daemon surges through the spear: +25 damage
-- against that husk (husks and corruption only -- Script 2's player
-- paths never call this), and the sync falls to 40. Anywhere else,
-- or below full sync, it returns 0 and the thrust is a plain 25.
function _G.JadeDaemonSurge(player)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return 0 end
	local nowS = os.clock()
	local r = st.Resonance or 0
	if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowS - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
	st.Resonance, st.ResonanceT = r, nowS
	if st.Form == "Weapon" and r >= 100 then
		st.Resonance = 40
		pushUpdate(player)
		return 25
	end
	return 0
end
function _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	return st and st.Form or "None"
end
transformEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)

	if stageOf(player) < MIN_STAGE then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastTransform or 0) < TRANSFORM_COOLDOWN then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if st.Form == "Bear" then

		if st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant then return end
		if st.PassengerSeat and st.PassengerSeat.Occupant then return end

		-- stowed: the Daemon unfolds into the Susanoo.
		local charNow = player.Character
		if charNow and charNow:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then

						local wingL, wingR = bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingL"), bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingR")
						if st.Flying then
							st.Stamina = math.max(0, (st.Stamina or 0) - 26 * 0.1)

						end
						if wingL then wingL.Transparency = 1 end
						if wingR then wingR.Transparency = 1 end
						if flight then flight.MaxForce = 0 end
						local speed = stats.Speed
						if st.Sprint and throttle > 0 and (st.Stamina or 0) > 0 then

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 41_Showcase.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Showcase
-- What it does: SHOW-OFF / PET SHOWCASE (Chapter 33). The pet is
-- the performance: this Script runs pedestal claims in the Hero's
-- Plaza, the pet ability showcase sequence (scaled by the pet's
-- rarity tier), overhead titles, and petal-burst entrances --
-- including Oakley's dedicated LEGEND entrance and the full
-- Dragon's Display for her GOLD JAPANESE DRAGON Daemon.
--
-- RARITY TIERS (server-decided, never client-claimed):
--   Legendary -- Oakley alone: the Gold Japanese Dragon (Script
--     39 kind GoldDragon) + the Headless Jade Skeleton. Full
--     5-act, 24-second Dragon's Display; Legend entrance.
--   Epic -- Pink (Design Package) or Blue (earned) Daemon bears.
--     4 acts, 16 seconds.
--   Rare -- Workbench-designed Daemons with a designed wing set.
--     3 acts, 12 seconds.
--   Common -- the starter Green Daemon bear. 2 acts, 8 seconds.
-- A showcase NEVER changes a number: no damage to players, no
-- counts, no rewards. The breath demo fires only at the plaza's
-- crystal demo target. Cooldown 60 s per player, server-side.
--
-- INTEGRATION: Script 39 publishes _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player)
-- (the keeper's live Daemon model) and _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)
-- ("Bear" / "Weapon" / "Susanoo"). Script 39's transform cycle
-- is requested through the same JadeBearTransform RemoteEvent it
-- already owns -- this Script never builds or destroys a Daemon.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN = 60
local PEDESTAL_HOLD = 120 -- seconds a claim lasts without renewal
local function remote(name)
	local r = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then
		r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); r.Name = name; r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	return r
end
local updateEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseUpdate")   -- server -> all: stage/effects
local requestEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseRequest") -- client -> server: start/pose/title
local entranceEvent = remote("JadeEntrance")        -- server -> all: entrance burst
local TITLES = {
	Keeper = { Text = "Bloom Keeper", Tier = "Common" },
	HuskFriend = { Text = "Friend of Husks", Tier = "Common" },
	TreeDefender = { Text = "Defender of the Tree", Tier = "Rare" },
	BlossomLegend = { Text = "Blossom Legend", Tier = "Epic" },
	DragonFriend = { Text = "Friend of Dragons", Tier = "Epic" },
	JadeLegend = { Text = "The Jade Legend -- Keeper of the Gold Dragon", Tier = "Legendary" },
}
local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Pedestal, LastShowcase, Title, Showcasing }
local function isLegend(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit") == true
end
local function tierOf(player)
	if isLegend(player) then return "Legendary" end
	local v = player:GetAttribute("DaemonVariant")
	if v == "Pink" or v == "Blue" then return "Epic" end
	if player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor") then return "Rare" end
	return "Common"
end
-- The Dragon's Display (Legendary) and its scaled-down forms.
-- Act = { Name, Seconds, Effect } -- the client renders Effect
-- (coil / design turn / flight / breath / weapon / finale lights
-- and petals); the server owns timing, order, and permission.
local SEQUENCES = {
	Legendary = {
		{ Name = "Grand Coil", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "The Design Turn", Seconds = 4, Effect = "DesignTurn" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Breath Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "GoldBreath" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
		{ Name = "Finale -- the Answer", Seconds = 2, Effect = "Finale" },
	},
	Epic = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Claw Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Rare = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Ability Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Common = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
}
local function daemonOf(player)
	if _G.JadeGetDaemonModel then return _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player) end

end
local function runShowcase(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or st.Showcasing then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastShowcase or -SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN) < SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN then return end
	local daemon = daemonOf(player)
	if not daemon then return end -- no condensed Daemon, no showcase
	st.Showcasing = true
	st.LastShowcase = now
	local tier = tierOf(player)
	player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseTier", tier)
	for i, act in ipairs(SEQUENCES[tier]) do
		if not player.Parent then break end
		player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseAct", act.Name)
		updateEvent:FireAllClients({
			UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Act = act.Name,
			Effect = act.Effect, Index = i, Seconds = act.Seconds,
			Pedestal = st.Pedestal,
		})
		task.wait(act.Seconds)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseAct", "")

end
-- ---------- pedestals (Hero's Plaza, World 1) -------------------

	for _, pedestal in ipairs(plaza:GetChildren()) do

			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)

				task.delay(PEDESTAL_HOLD, function()
					if st.Pedestal == pedestal.Name then

	end
end
-- ---------- titles ----------------------------------------------
local function applyTitle(player, titleId)
	local def = TITLES[titleId]
	if not def then return end
	if def.Tier == "Legendary" and not isLegend(player) then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local old = root:FindFirstChild("ShowcaseTitle")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "ShowcaseTitle"; gui.Size = UDim2.new(6, 0, 1, 0)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0); gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = def.Text; label.TextScaled = true

	label.TextColor3 = def.Tier == "Legendary" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)

		or Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 220)
	label.Parent = gui; gui.Parent = root

end
-- ---------- entrances -------------------------------------------
local function fireEntrance(player, area)
	local tier = tierOf(player)
	entranceEvent:FireAllClients({
		UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Area = area or "World",
		-- Legendary = Oakley's dedicated moment: bell, petal burst,

		Legend = isLegend(player),
	})
end
requestEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return end
	if action == "StartShowcase" then

end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	state[player.UserId] = {}

end)

end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 43_WeaponChoice.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it WeaponChoice
-- What it does: THE FIRST CHOICE (Chapter 34). Before the tutorial,
-- before the Daemon Garden, before World 1 itself, a first-time
-- player stands on the Threshold and chooses a weapon TYPE. Only
-- then does the branch manifest (Script 45) and the game begin.
--
-- * THE FOUR STARTERS (the whole launch roster): Spear, Katana,
--   Scythe, Hammer. Each type is a base character AND a companion:
--   Spear -> the wooden Sprite, Katana -> the wooden Fox, Scythe ->
--   the wooden Serpent, Hammer -> the wooden Bear Cub. The pairing
--   is 1:1 and lives in this table; Script 45 reads the same names.
-- * ALL FOUR ARE FREE, forever. No type is sold, granted by a pass,
--   or dropped by a quest. Damage is 25 for every type (Script 2's
--   pattern); the types differ in reach, arc, and rhythm only --
--   style stats, published in WEAPON_TYPES below and in Chapter 34.
-- * THE TWINS ARE NOT IN THE CHOICE. The twin guardian accounts
--   (the same UserIds as Scripts 8/35/39) are settled server-side:
--   both are Spear by birthright, and Oakley's account never sees
--   the Threshold at all -- her companion is the Gold Dragon
--   (Script 39), not a branch creature, and no choice can change
--   that. With an ID still 0, nobody is special-cased (fail-closed).
-- * HOLD: a player with no saved choice is teleported to the
--   Threshold platform (Workspace > Threshold > ThresholdSpawn) on
--   every spawn and cannot leave it until they choose: the exit
--   gate is this Script, and it opens only after a saved choice.
-- * STORAGE: DataStore "JadeWeaponChoice_v1", key = UserId, value =
--   the type name. The choice is also published as the WeaponType
--   attribute, which Scripts 33/39/45 read. Re-choosing is free at
--   the Spirit Workbench (Chapter 28): fire the same RemoteEvent
--   while standing at the Workbench -- this Script re-checks the
--   player's zone either way, and a re-choice never touches counts,
--   stages, or unlocks (those belong to the player, Chapter 4).
--
-- SECURITY: the client sends ONE string. It must be a string, it
-- must be a key of WEAPON_TYPES, and that is the entire trust
-- surface. There is no fifth type a client can name into being.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Scripts 8/35/39)
local TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with his UserId
local WEAPON_TYPES = {
	Spear  = { Companion = "Sprite",  Reach = 11, Arc = 40,  Cooldown = 0.55 },
	Katana = { Companion = "Fox",     Reach = 8,  Arc = 90,  Cooldown = 0.45 },
	Scythe = { Companion = "Serpent", Reach = 10, Arc = 120, Cooldown = 0.65 },
	Hammer = { Companion = "BearCub", Reach = 7,  Arc = 70,  Cooldown = 0.80 },
}
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeWeaponChoice_v1")
local chosen = {} -- [UserId] = typeName
local choiceEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
choiceEvent.Name = "JadeWeaponChoice"
choiceEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local openEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
openEvent.Name = "JadeWeaponChoiceOpen"
openEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local function isTwin(player)
	return (TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID)
		or (TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID)
end
local function applyChoice(player, typeName, save)
	chosen[player.UserId] = typeName
	player:SetAttribute("WeaponType", typeName)
	player:SetAttribute("CompanionSpecies", WEAPON_TYPES[typeName].Companion)
	if save then
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), typeName) end)
	end
	-- The branch hears about it from the attribute; Script 45 builds
	-- the seed branch and grows the companion from it.
	if _G.JadeBranchOnChoice then _G.JadeBranchOnChoice(player, typeName) end
end
local function holdAtThreshold(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local threshold = workspace:FindFirstChild("Threshold")
	local spawn = threshold and threshold:FindFirstChild("ThresholdSpawn")
	if char and spawn then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
	openEvent:FireClient(player)
end
local function releaseToWorld(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local gate = workspace:FindFirstChild("ThresholdExitSpawn")
	if char and gate then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = gate.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
end
local function onJoin(player)
	if isTwin(player) then
		applyChoice(player, "Spear", false) -- birthright; never saved as a "choice"
		return
	end
	local saved
	pcall(function() saved = store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
	if type(saved) == "string" and WEAPON_TYPES[saved] then
		applyChoice(player, saved, false)
	else
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(0.5)
				if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
			end)
		end
	end
end
choiceEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, typeName)
	if type(typeName) ~= "string" then return end
	if not WEAPON_TYPES[typeName] then return end
	local firstChoice = chosen[player.UserId] == nil
	applyChoice(player, typeName, true)
	if firstChoice then releaseToWorld(player) end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) chosen[player.UserId] = nil end)
]]></ProtectedString>

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 45_BranchCompanion.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it BranchCompanion
-- What it does: ONE BEING, THREE FORMS (Chapter 34).
--
-- 1. THE BRANCH -- a living cutting of the World Tree: dark WOOD
--    with blossoms of PINK QUARTZ. It is the seed form and the
--    resting form of every keeper's partner, and its shape echoes
--    the chosen weapon (a spear branch grows long and straight
--    with its blossoms clustered at the tip; a scythe branch grows
--    in a crescent; a hammer branch thick and knotted; a katana
--    branch in one gentle curve).
-- 2. THE COMPANION -- the branch GROWS: limbs, a head, a heart of
--    quartz light. One species per weapon, 1:1, decided by the
--    First Choice (Script 43): Spear -> Sprite, Katana -> Fox,
--    Scythe -> Serpent, Hammer -> Bear Cub. Wooden bodies, pink
--    quartz blossom features, pink-and-brown only -- the unified
--    base palette of Chapter 34. The companion walks beside its
--    keeper, answers first (the Answer), and shivers its blossoms
--    on every return (the Shiver).
-- 3. THE WEAPON -- Soul Eater style: the companion transforms INTO
--    the weapon, one object of wood and pink quartz. There is no
--    companion floating beside a wielded weapon and no weapon
--    beside a standing companion: equip the Tool and the companion
--    pours into it (0.8 s); stow the Tool and the weapon pours
--    back out (0.8 s) -- through the branch, always (0.6 s hub).
--
-- * OAKLEY IS THE EXCEPTION, fail-closed: her account (the same
--   UserId as Scripts 8/35/39) gets NO branch and NO branch
--   companion from this Script, ever. Her partner is the Gold
--   Japanese Dragon (Script 39), and her forms are hers alone.
-- * THE BOND: Script 2 reports every connecting hit to
--   _G.JadeDaemonThrust (Script 39) -- and, on the same line, to
--   _G.JadeBranchOnHit below. Each reported hit raises the pair's
--   visible bond glow (the BranchBond attribute, 0-100): +8 per
--   hit, decaying 6/s -- the same rhythm as Script 39's Resonance,
--   so the blossoms brighten exactly as the sync builds. The
--   SURGE itself (100 -> the next hit strikes for 50, sync falls
--   to 40) is Script 39's, Stage 2+; this Script only makes the
--   bond VISIBLE, in the quartz, from the first minute.
-- * States are published as attributes: BranchState ("Branch" /
--   "Companion" / "Transforming" / "Weapon") and CompanionSpecies.
--   Script 39's cycle routes through here: no form becomes another
--   form directly -- Beast and Susanoo unfold from the Branch,
--   which is why stowing the weapon always lands on the branch
--   first.
--
-- SECURITY: clients send nothing to this Script. Forms change on
-- server-observed events only (choice saved, Tool equipped/stowed,
-- respawn), and the models it builds are server-built parts.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Scripts 8/35/39/43)
local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(92, 60, 40)        -- brown heartwood
local WOOD_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(66, 42, 28)
local QUARTZ = Color3.fromRGB(255, 122, 184)   -- pink quartz
local QUARTZ_LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 178, 216)
local TRANSFORM_SECONDS = 0.8  -- companion <-> weapon
local HUB_SECONDS = 0.6        -- every change passes through the branch
local GROW_SECONDS = 1.6       -- branch -> companion (first growth)
local SHAPES = { -- branch silhouettes: segment count, curve, cluster placement
	Spear  = { Segments = 5, Curve = 0.02, ClusterAt = "Tip",   Scale = 1.15 },
	Katana = { Segments = 5, Curve = 0.22, ClusterAt = "Curve", Scale = 1.00 },
	Scythe = { Segments = 6, Curve = 0.55, ClusterAt = "Arc",   Scale = 1.25 },
	Hammer = { Segments = 3, Curve = 0.05, ClusterAt = "End",   Scale = 0.90 },
}
local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Model, Form, Bond, BondT, Root }
local function part(parent, size, cf, color, material, name)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size = size; p.CFrame = cf; p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Wood
	p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Name = name or "Part"
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end
local function blossom(parent, cf, s)
	-- one pink quartz blossom: five petals around a bright heart
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local a = (i / 5) * math.pi * 2
		part(parent, Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.22) * s,
			cf * CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.22 * s, math.sin(a) * 0.22 * s, 0),
			QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "Petal")
	end
	local heart = part(parent, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2) * s, cf, QUARTZ_LIGHT, Enum.Material.Neon, "Heart")
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = QUARTZ; light.Range = 4; light.Brightness = 0.6
	light.Parent = heart
	return heart
end
local function buildBranch(player, typeName)
	local shape = SHAPES[typeName]; if not shape then return nil end
	local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = "BranchDaemon"
	local base = CFrame.new()
	local pos = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0); local ang = 0
	for i = 1, shape.Segments do
		ang += shape.Curve
		local seg = part(model, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.28, 0.28) * shape.Scale,
			base * CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Limb")
		if i == 1 then model.PrimaryPart = seg end
		pos += Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * 1.0 * shape.Scale, math.sin(ang) * 1.0 * shape.Scale, 0)
		blossom(model, base * CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang), 0.8)
	end
	blossom(model, base * CFrame.new(pos), 1.5) -- the crown cluster: the future quartz heart of the weapon
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
local function buildCompanion(player, species)
	-- Stylized server builds in the part grammar of Chapter 34;
	-- the Studio display models carry the full sculpted detail.
	local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = species .. "Companion"
	local body = part(model, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.6, 0.7), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Body")
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 2.7, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Head")
	if species == "Fox" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.25, 3.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.2), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Ear")
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame.new(0.25, 3.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.2), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Ear")
		local tail = part(model, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.8, 0.7), CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0.9) * CFrame.Angles(0.7, 0, 0), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "BlossomTail")
		blossom(model, tail.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 0), 1.3)
	elseif species == "Serpent" then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.5, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 0.4, i * 0.7) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, i * 0.15), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Coil")
		end
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 2.6, 0.4), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "ScaleCrest")
	elseif species == "BearCub" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.2, 1.0), CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "CubBody")
		for _, x in ipairs({ -0.6, 0.6 }) do
			local paw = part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.4, 0.6), CFrame.new(x, 0.25, -0.5), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Paw")
			part(model, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.3), paw.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.1, -0.3), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Neon, "QuartzClaws")
		end
	elseif species == "Sprite" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.1, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.3, 0.5, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Leg")
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.1, 0.3), CFrame.new(0.3, 0.5, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Leg")
		blossom(model, CFrame.new(0, 3.35, 0), 1.2) -- the blossom crown
	end
	blossom(model, CFrame.new(0, 2.05, -0.4), 1.0) -- the heart blossom, shared by every species
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
local function setForm(player, form)
	local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st then return end
	st.Form = form
	player:SetAttribute("BranchState", form)
	if st.Model then st.Model:Destroy(); st.Model = nil end
	local typeName = player:GetAttribute("WeaponType")
	if form == "Branch" and typeName then
		st.Model = buildBranch(player, typeName)
	elseif form == "Companion" then
		st.Model = buildCompanion(player, player:GetAttribute("CompanionSpecies") or "Sprite")
	end
end
function _G.JadeBranchOnChoice(player, typeName)
	if TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID then return end
	state[player.UserId] = state[player.UserId] or { Form = "None", Bond = 0 }
	setForm(player, "Branch")
	task.delay(GROW_SECONDS, function()
		if state[player.UserId] and state[player.UserId].Form == "Branch" then
			setForm(player, "Companion") -- the Answer: it looks at its keeper first (follow code turns it so)
		end
	end)
end
function _G.JadeBranchOnHit(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local b = st.Bond or 0
	if st.BondT then b = math.max(0, b - (now - st.BondT) * 6) end
	st.Bond = math.min(100, b + 8); st.BondT = now
	player:SetAttribute("BranchBond", math.floor(st.Bond))
end
local function watchCharacter(player, char)
	local function onTool(tool)
		if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
		local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st or st.Form == "Weapon" then return end
		player:SetAttribute("BranchState", "Transforming")
		task.delay(TRANSFORM_SECONDS, function()
			if state[player.UserId] then setForm(player, "Weapon") end
		end)
		tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent == nil and state[player.UserId] then
				setForm(player, "Branch") -- through the hub, always
				task.delay(HUB_SECONDS, function()
					if state[player.UserId] and state[player.UserId].Form == "Branch" then
						setForm(player, "Companion")
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(onTool)
	for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do onTool(c) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) watchCharacter(player, char) end)
	if player.Character then watchCharacter(player, player.Character) end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if st and st.Model then st.Model:Destroy() end
	state[player.UserId] = nil
end)
-- Follow: branch and companion hold station at the keeper's left,
-- bobbing gently; the companion turns to face the keeper's facing
-- (the Answer, every frame, not just on arrival).
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(t)
	local now = os.clock()
	for userId, st in pairs(state) do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local char = player and player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and st.Model and st.Model.PrimaryPart then
			local bob = math.sin(now * 1.6 + userId % 7) * 0.18
			local target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-3.2, st.Form == "Branch" and 1.2 or 0, 1.2)
			if st.Form == "Companion" then
				target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-3.2, -2.6, 1.2) -- feet near the keeper's ground line
			end
			local cur = st.Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
			st.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cur:Lerp(target + Vector3.new(0, bob + 2.6, 0), 0.12))
		end
		if st.BondT and now - st.BondT > 0.25 then -- decay the visible bond
			st.Bond = math.max(0, (st.Bond or 0) - 6 * (now - st.BondT)); st.BondT = now
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if p then p:SetAttribute("BranchBond", math.floor(st.Bond)) end
		end
	end
end)
]]></ProtectedString>

			<Properties>
				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 47_Wings.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Wings
-- What it does: THE FOUR WINGS (Chapter 36). Wings -- not outfits --
-- are this game's primary visual customization. Four types, all
-- pink and brown, each paired with a flight style:
--
--   Feathered  pink feathers, brown tips. THE STARTER WINGS:
--              granted with flight itself (Susanoo Stage 3 --
--              15,000 Lifetime + 100 Essence, Scripts 35/39).
--   Crystal    brown wooden frame, pink quartz membranes.
--              Unlock: reach the Crystal Deep (10,000 Lifetime,
--              Script 19) and craft at the Workbench for Blooms.
--   Butterfly  pink-and-brown patterned. Unlock: free 100 Thorn
--              Husks (Script 4's count) -- the garden's gratitude.
--   Dragon     brown scales, pink membranes. Unlock: hold the
--              Tree through 10 Hollow assaults (Script 31) -- the
--              endgame wings. (A wing TYPE any keeper can earn;
--              Oakley's Gold Dragon is a Daemon, not a wing, and
--              is untouched by this Script.)
--
-- * FLIGHT ITSELF NEVER CHANGES: Script 39 owns flight -- Stage 3,
--   stamina 100 draining 26/s, the stage speed table. Wing types
--   tune FEEL inside those caps (the style table below: climb,
--   glide, turn multipliers, each between 0.9 and 1.1, published
--   in Chapter 36). Top speed and stamina are identical for every
--   wing. Style is the ladder; power is not for sale or unlock.
-- * Selection is by NAME from this whitelist, validated here;
--   ownership is re-checked on every select and on every join.
--   Unlocks persist in DataStore "JadeWings_v1" (a set of type
--   names) and are published as attributes: WingType (worn now)
--   and four OwnsWing<Type> booleans Script 48 renders.
-- * Flight-style application: this Script publishes WingClimb,
--   WingGlide, WingTurn attributes from the style table; Script 39
--   may read them as multipliers inside its own caps (documented
--   hook -- if it does not, the wings are purely visual and every
--   number in Chapter 36 still holds).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local WING_TYPES = {
	Feathered = { Climb = 1.0, Glide = 1.1, Turn = 1.0 },
	Crystal   = { Climb = 1.1, Glide = 0.9, Turn = 1.0 },
	Butterfly = { Climb = 0.9, Glide = 1.1, Turn = 1.1 },
	Dragon    = { Climb = 1.1, Glide = 1.0, Turn = 0.9 },
}
local CRAFT_BLOOMS = 25 -- Crystal wings, paid in Crystal Blooms at the Workbench
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeWings_v1")
local owned = {} -- [UserId] = { [typeName] = true }
local selectEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
selectEvent.Name = "JadeWingSelect"
selectEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local function publish(player)
	local set = owned[player.UserId] or {}
	for name in pairs(WING_TYPES) do
		player:SetAttribute("OwnsWing" .. name, set[name] == true)
	end
	local worn = player:GetAttribute("WingType")
	if worn and WING_TYPES[worn] then
		local s = WING_TYPES[worn]
		player:SetAttribute("WingClimb", s.Climb)
		player:SetAttribute("WingGlide", s.Glide)
		player:SetAttribute("WingTurn", s.Turn)
	end
end
local function grant(player, name, save)
	owned[player.UserId] = owned[player.UserId] or {}
	owned[player.UserId][name] = true
	if save then
		local list = {}
		for k in pairs(owned[player.UserId]) do table.insert(list, k) end
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), list) end)
	end
	publish(player)
end
-- Called by the systems that EARN wings (documented hooks; each
-- caller is itself server-side and already counts the deed).
function _G.JadeGrantWing(player, name)
	if WING_TYPES[name] then grant(player, name, true) end
end
-- Flight unlock (Stage 3) grants the starter wings: Script 35/39
-- may call this at the Stage-3 transition; the attribute watch
-- below also catches it, so the grant cannot be missed.
local function watchStage(player)
	local function check()
		if (player:GetAttribute("SusanooStage") or 0) >= 3 then
			if not (owned[player.UserId] and owned[player.UserId].Feathered) then
				grant(player, "Feathered", true)
				if not player:GetAttribute("WingType") then
					player:SetAttribute("WingType", "Feathered"); publish(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SusanooStage"):Connect(check)
	check()
end
local function onJoin(player)
	owned[player.UserId] = {}
	local saved
	pcall(function() saved = store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
	if type(saved) == "table" then
		for _, name in ipairs(saved) do
			if WING_TYPES[name] then owned[player.UserId][name] = true end
		end
	end
	publish(player)
	watchStage(player)
end
selectEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not WING_TYPES[name] then return end
	if not (owned[player.UserId] and owned[player.UserId][name]) then return end
	player:SetAttribute("WingType", name)
	publish(player)
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) owned[player.UserId] = nil end)

				<ProtectedString name="Source"><![CDATA[-- Jade Spirit | 49_ColosseumSystem.server.lua
-- What it does: THE COLOSSEUM (Chapter 46) -- pay-to-view live
-- Last Man Standing King of the Hill. Owns the contestant queue,
-- the Spend-Balance buy-in pool, eliminations, FREE predictions,
-- and LIVE SPECTATOR ENTITLEMENTS (the pay-to-view tickets).
--
-- MONEY LAW (Chapters 6 and 46):
-- * Tickets are Robux products, sold ONLY through Script 10's
--   receipt pipeline. This script never sets ProcessReceipt.
--   Script 10 routes the two ticket product IDs below to
--   _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket, exactly once per PurchaseId.
-- * Contestants are NEVER paid Robux. The prize pool is Spend
--   Balance (Bonus thrusts), paid through Script 13. A game
--   cannot hand Robux to players; Chapter 46 says so on the page.
-- * Predictions are FREE. No Robux, no Spend, no items are ever
--   wagered, by anyone, on any match (Chapter 46, prediction law).
-- * Buy-ins spend Spend Balance only (Script 13's
--   JadeSpendThrusts): Lifetime, ranks, gates and tiers can
--   never be lost in the Colosseum. Losers lose the buy-in.
--   The winner takes the whole pool. That is the stake.
--
-- SECURITY (Chapter 14's rules, applied):
-- * Every client action is re-checked server-side: distance to
--   the Entry Gate for entry, entitlement for the live stands,
--   contestant status for predictions (contestants may not
--   predict their own match), one action per second per player.
-- * Product and pass IDs live ONLY in this config table; a
--   client-supplied ID is never trusted or even read.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CONFIG = {
	TicketProductId = 0, -- Developer Product: Live Match Ticket (49 Robux)
	DayPassProductId = 0, -- Developer Product: Live Day Pass (99 Robux)
	SeasonPassId = 0, -- Game Pass: Colosseum Season Pass (299 Robux)
	MaxContestants = 8, -- Chapter 46: 8 fight, the rest watch
	MinContestants = 4,
	BuyIns = { 250, 1000 }, -- Spend Balance tiers, Chapter 46
	PrizePerNetRobux = 10, -- Bonus thrusts per prize-fund Robux
}
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeColosseum")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "JadeColosseum"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local state = {
	Phase = "Lobby", -- Lobby | Live | Finished
	MatchId = 0,
	Pool = 0, -- Spend Balance escrowed from buy-ins
	Contestants = {}, -- [Player] = { Alive=bool, BuyIn=n, HillTime=n }
	Predictions = {}, -- [Player] = Player (their pick) -- FREE
	Tickets = {}, -- [Player] = matchId the ticket is valid for
	DayPassUntil = {}, -- [Player] = os.time() expiry
	SeasonCache = {}, -- [Player] = bool
	Rollover = 0, -- pool carried when a match has no winner
}
local lastAction = {}
local function aliveCount()
	local n = 0
	for _, c in pairs(state.Contestants) do
		if c.Alive then n += 1 end
	end
	return n
end
local function broadcast()
	local roster = {}
	for p, c in pairs(state.Contestants) do
		table.insert(roster, {
			Name = p.Name,
			Alive = c.Alive,
			HillTime = math.floor(c.HillTime),
		})
	end
	remote:FireAllClients("State", {
		Phase = state.Phase,
		MatchId = state.MatchId,
		Pool = state.Pool + state.Rollover,
		Alive = aliveCount(),
		Roster = roster,
	})
end
-- ---------- pay-to-view entitlement (Chapter 46) ----------------
function _G.JadeColosseumHasLiveAccess(player)
	if state.Contestants[player] then return true end -- fighters are in
	if state.Tickets[player] == state.MatchId then return true end
	local day = state.DayPassUntil[player]
	if day and os.time() < day then return true end
	if state.SeasonCache[player] == nil and CONFIG.SeasonPassId > 0 then
		local ok, owns = pcall(function()
			return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(
				player.UserId, CONFIG.SeasonPassId)
		end)
		state.SeasonCache[player] = ok and owns or false
	end
	return state.SeasonCache[player] == true
end
-- Called ONLY by Script 10's ProcessReceipt, once per PurchaseId.
function _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket(player, productId)
	if productId == CONFIG.TicketProductId and CONFIG.TicketProductId > 0 then
		state.Tickets[player] = state.MatchId + (state.Phase == "Live" and 0 or 1)
		return true
	elseif productId == CONFIG.DayPassProductId and CONFIG.DayPassProductId > 0 then
		state.DayPassUntil[player] = os.time() + 24 * 3600
		return true
	end
	return false
end
-- ---------- the prize: pool + ticket-funded bonus -------------
local function payWinner(winner)
	local pool = state.Pool + state.Rollover
	state.Pool, state.Rollover = 0, 0
	if pool > 0 and _G.JadeGrantBonus then
		-- Script 13 clamps one grant to 500; pay in honest chunks.
		local left = pool
		while left > 0 do
			local chunk = math.min(left, 500)
			_G.JadeGrantBonus(winner, chunk, "ColosseumWinner")
			left -= chunk
		end
	end
	remote:FireAllClients("Winner", { Name = winner.Name, Pool = pool })
end
-- ---------- match flow ------------------------------------------
local function eliminate(player, _cause)
	local c = state.Contestants[player]
	if not c or not c.Alive or state.Phase ~= "Live" then return end
	c.Alive = false
	if aliveCount() == 1 then
		for p, cc in pairs(state.Contestants) do
			if cc.Alive then
				state.Phase = "Finished"
				payWinner(p)
			end
		end
	elseif aliveCount() == 0 then
		-- The zombies took everyone: NO winner, and all-or-nothing
		-- means exactly that -- the whole pool rolls to next match.
		state.Phase = "Finished"
		state.Rollover += state.Pool
		state.Pool = 0
		remote:FireAllClients("NoWinner", { Rollover = state.Rollover })
	end
	broadcast()
end
_G.JadeColosseumEliminate = eliminate
local function startMatch()
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(state.Contestants) do n += 1 end
	if n < CONFIG.MinContestants then return false end
	state.MatchId += 1
	state.Phase = "Live"
	state.Predictions = {}
	for player, c in pairs(state.Contestants) do
		c.Alive = true
		c.HillTime = 0
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then
			hum.Died:Connect(function() eliminate(player, "Fell") end)
		end
		local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("ColosseumSpawn_" .. ((n % 8) + 1))
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if spawn and root then root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
		n -= 1
	end
	broadcast()
	return true
end
_G.JadeColosseumStart = startMatch
-- ---------- client actions (all re-checked) ---------------------
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastAction[player] and now - lastAction[player] < 1 then return end
	lastAction[player] = now
	if action == "EnterContest" then
		if state.Phase ~= "Lobby" then return end
		local count = 0
		for _ in pairs(state.Contestants) do count += 1 end
		if count >= CONFIG.MaxContestants or state.Contestants[player] then return end
		local tier = (arg == 2) and CONFIG.BuyIns[2] or CONFIG.BuyIns[1]
		-- Qualifiers enter free: Script 41/42 grant the item.
		local qualified = _G.JadeGetItem and _G.JadeGetItem(player, "ColosseumToken") or 0
		if qualified > 0 then
			_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "ColosseumToken", -1)
			state.Contestants[player] = { Alive = false, BuyIn = 0, HillTime = 0 }
		elseif _G.JadeSpendThrusts and _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, tier, "ColosseumBuyIn") then
			state.Contestants[player] = { Alive = false, BuyIn = tier, HillTime = 0 }
			state.Pool += tier
		end
		broadcast()
	elseif action == "Predict" then
		-- FREE. Spectators only; locked once Wave 3 begins is
		-- enforced by Script 29/31 calling JadeColosseumLockPicks,
		-- after which this branch refuses (Phase stays Live but
		-- PicksLocked is set server-side).
		if state.Contestants[player] then return end
		if state.PicksLocked then return end
		for p in pairs(state.Contestants) do
			if p.Name == arg then
				state.Predictions[player] = p
				return
			end
		end
	elseif action == "EnterLiveStands" then
		-- The pay-to-view gate itself: no entitlement, no teleport.
		if not _G.JadeColosseumHasLiveAccess(player) then
			remote:FireClient(player, "NeedTicket", {
				TicketProductId = CONFIG.TicketProductId,
				DayPassProductId = CONFIG.DayPassProductId,
				SeasonPassId = CONFIG.SeasonPassId,
			})
			return
		end
		local stands = workspace:FindFirstChild("ColosseumStandsSpawn")
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if stands and root then root.CFrame = stands.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
		remote:FireClient(player, "LiveAccess", { MatchId = state.MatchId })
	end
end)
function _G.JadeColosseumLockPicks()
	state.PicksLocked = true
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	state.Contestants[player] = nil
	state.Predictions[player] = nil
	state.Tickets[player] = nil
	state.DayPassUntil[player] = nil
	state.SeasonCache[player] = nil
	lastAction[player] = nil
	if state.Phase == "Live" then eliminate(player, "Left") end
end)
print("[Jade Spirit] Colosseum ready -- pay-to-view live, predictions free, pool in Spend only.")
-- ---------- VIEW CREDIT — the loyalty loop (Chapter 47) --------
-- Earned ONLY by Sales Vault spend (Script 51 calls the grant
-- below, from Script 10's completed receipts): 1 Robux spent in
-- the Vault = 1 View Credit. Watching live on credit burns
-- 1 credit per minute, times the match's popularity multiplier
-- (Chapter 47's calibration table). Credit is never sold, never
-- transferred, never wagered, and never expires; the balance is
-- capped at 600 so the bank stays a treat, not a second wallet.
local VIEW_CAP = 600
local viewCredit = {} -- [Player] = minutes banked
-- View Credit NEVER expires (Chapter 47), so the bank is persisted
-- like every other promise in this game: a DataStore record per
-- player, loaded on join and saved whenever the balance moves.
-- Without this, "never expires" would quietly mean "until logout".
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local creditStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_ViewCredit_v1")
local function saveCredit(player)
	local balance = viewCredit[player]
	if balance == nil then return end
	pcall(function()
		creditStore:SetAsync("credit_" .. player.UserId, balance)
	end)
end
local creditWatchers = {} -- [Player] = true while burning credit
state.Popularity = 1.0 -- set at match start: 1.0 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 2.0
function _G.JadeGrantViewCredit(player, robuxSpent)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	robuxSpent = math.floor(tonumber(robuxSpent) or 0)
	if robuxSpent <= 0 then return end
	viewCredit[player] = math.min(VIEW_CAP, (viewCredit[player] or 0) + robuxSpent)
	saveCredit(player)
	remote:FireClient(player, "ViewCredit", { Balance = viewCredit[player] })
end
function _G.JadeGetViewCredit(player)
	return viewCredit[player] or 0
end
function _G.JadeSetPopularity(mult)
	if mult == 1.25 or mult == 1.5 or mult == 2.0 then
		state.Popularity = mult
	else
		state.Popularity = 1.0
	end
end
-- A second listener on the same RemoteEvent: credit entry.
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action)
	if action == "EnterStandsOnCredit" then
		if state.Contestants[player] then return end
		if _G.JadeColosseumHasLiveAccess(player) then return end -- tickets first: they never burn credit
		if (viewCredit[player] or 0) < 10 then
			remote:FireClient(player, "ViewCredit", {
				Balance = viewCredit[player] or 0, Denied = true,
			})
			return
		end
		local stands = workspace:FindFirstChild("ColosseumStandsSpawn")
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if stands and root then
			root.CFrame = stands.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			creditWatchers[player] = true
			remote:FireClient(player, "LiveAccess", { MatchId = state.MatchId, OnCredit = true })
		end
	end
end)
-- The burn loop + the match-duration log (Chapter 47 calibration:
-- Script 49 records every match's real duration; the planning
-- model is re-based on the MEDIAN of the last 20, never the mean).
local matchStartedAt = nil
local durationLog = {}
local _startMatch = _G.JadeColosseumStart
_G.JadeColosseumStart = function()
	local ok = _startMatch()
	if ok then matchStartedAt = os.clock() end
	return ok
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		if state.Phase == "Live" then
			for player in pairs(creditWatchers) do
				local cost = 1 * state.Popularity
				viewCredit[player] = math.max(0, (viewCredit[player] or 0) - cost)
				saveCredit(player)
				remote:FireClient(player, "ViewCredit", { Balance = viewCredit[player] })
				if viewCredit[player] < 1 then
					creditWatchers[player] = nil
					remote:FireClient(player, "CreditEmpty", {})
				end
			end
		end
		if state.Phase == "Finished" and matchStartedAt then
			table.insert(durationLog, math.floor(os.clock() - matchStartedAt))
			matchStartedAt = nil
			creditWatchers = {}
			if #durationLog >= 20 then
				local sorted = table.clone(durationLog)
				table.sort(sorted)
				warn(("[Jade Spirit] Colosseum median match (last 20): %ds")
					:format(sorted[math.ceil(#sorted / 2)]))
				durationLog = {}
			end
		end
	end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, saved = pcall(function()
		return creditStore:GetAsync("credit_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and type(saved) == "number" then
		viewCredit[player] = math.clamp(saved, 0, VIEW_CAP)
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	saveCredit(player)
	viewCredit[player] = nil
	creditWatchers[player] = nil
end)
-- Popularity, set at every match start from the Character Value
-- board (Script 53, Chapter 48) -- counted ranks, not opinions:
-- any contestant ranked 4-10 = Featured 1.25; ranked 1-3 =
-- Star 1.5; two or more ranked 1-3 = Marquee 2.0 (Chapter 47).
local _startWithRate = _G.JadeColosseumStart
_G.JadeColosseumStart = function()
	local mult = 1.0
	if _G.JadeGetValueBoard then
		local ranks = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(_G.JadeGetValueBoard()) do
			ranks[entry.Name] = entry.Rank
		end
		local top3, top10 = 0, 0
		for player in pairs(state.Contestants) do
			local r = ranks[player.Name]
			if r and r <= 3 then top3 += 1
			elseif r and r <= 10 then top10 += 1 end
		end
		if top3 >= 2 then mult = 2.0
		elseif top3 >= 1 then mult = 1.5
		elseif top10 >= 1 then mult = 1.25 end
	end
	_G.JadeSetPopularity(mult)
	return _startWithRate()
end
-- Phase getter for the tuning system (Chapter 50): adjustments
-- may only land between matches, and this is how they know.
function _G.JadeColosseumPhase()
	return state.Phase
end

-- What it does: THE SALES VAULT (Chapter 47) -- the monetization
-- hub. Owns the weapon-skin catalogue, ownership, and equipping.
--
-- COSMETIC LAW (Chapters 44 and 47): a skin changes materials,
-- colours, and trail presentation ONLY. Damage (25, Script 2),
-- reach, arc, cooldown, and hitboxes are read from the weapon's
-- own table in Scripts 2/43 and are never touched here. This
-- script writes one attribute -- EquippedSkin_<Weapon> -- and
-- presentation systems read it. That is the whole of its power.
--
-- MONEY LAW: skins are Developer Products at 80 Robux (the
-- $0.99 tier, Chapter 47) with PERMANENT ownership recorded from
-- Script 10's receipts -- Script 10 routes each skin's product
-- ID to _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin, once per PurchaseId (Chapter 14).
-- Every granted skin also grants VIEW CREDIT (Chapter 47's
-- loyalty loop): 1 Robux spent = 1 minute of Colosseum view
-- time, through Script 49's JadeGrantViewCredit.
-- Oakley's Golden Dragon Rifle has NO skin, NO product, and NO
-- entry in this catalogue, and never will (Chapters 9 and 36).
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
-- ProductId 0 = not yet created in the Dashboard (Chapter 47's
-- setup steps). A skin with ID 0 cannot be prompted or granted.
local SKINS = {
	{ Key = "SpearVerdant", Weapon = "Spear", Name = "Verdant Grain", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Grove" },
	{ Key = "SpearEmberwood", Weapon = "Spear", Name = "Emberwood", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Blossom" },
	{ Key = "SpearMoonquill", Weapon = "Spear", Name = "Moonquill Crystal", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Crystal" },
	{ Key = "KatanaPetalsteel", Weapon = "Katana", Name = "Petalsteel", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Grove" },
	{ Key = "KatanaStormsilk", Weapon = "Katana", Name = "Stormsilk", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Blossom" },
	{ Key = "KatanaNightbloom", Weapon = "Katana", Name = "Nightbloom", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Crystal" },
	{ Key = "ScytheHuskwood", Weapon = "Scythe", Name = "Huskwood", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Grove" },
	{ Key = "ScytheRoseglass", Weapon = "Scythe", Name = "Roseglass", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Blossom" },
	{ Key = "ScytheSerpentine", Weapon = "Scythe", Name = "Serpentine Jade", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Crystal" },
	{ Key = "HammerBarkheart", Weapon = "Hammer", Name = "Barkheart", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Grove" },
	{ Key = "HammerGoldvein", Weapon = "Hammer", Name = "Goldvein", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Blossom" },
	{ Key = "HammerCubheart", Weapon = "Hammer", Name = "Cubheart", ProductId = 0, Rarity = "Crystal" },

-- What it does: CHARACTER VALUE, the prestige ranking
-- (Chapter 48). One number, three measured factors, computed
-- server-side from records that already exist:
--   VALUE = 0.50 x SwingScore + 0.25 x TimeScore + 0.25 x ClosetScore
--   SwingScore  = Lifetime swings / 10            (Script 13)
--   TimeScore   = ACTIVE playtime minutes x 2     (this script)
--   ClosetScore = rarity points of owned closet   (Script 51
--                 for skins; this table for other cosmetics)
-- A minute of playtime counts only if the character moved more
-- than 5 studs in it -- an AFK keeper is present, not playing,
-- and prestige pays for playing. Clients receive the finished
-- board and nothing else; no client input reaches this math.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpiritValue_v1")
local playMinutes, lastPos, moved = {}, {}, {}
local board = {}
local CLOSET_POINTS = { Grove = 100, Blossom = 250, Crystal = 500, Eternal = 1000, Singular = 2500 }
-- Rarity of the permanent cosmetics outside the Vault, by their
-- Chapter 6/28/31/35 catalogue entries. Consumables never count.
local OTHER_CLOSET = {
	OwnsPetalTrailPack = "Grove", OwnsGoldenSpearSkin = "Blossom",
	OwnsBloomAuraEffects = "Blossom", OwnsSakuraQueenSkin = "Crystal",
	OwnsExtraPetSlot = "Crystal", OwnsDaemonDesignPack = "Eternal",
	OwnsTwilightReaperPack = "Eternal", OwnsGroveVIP = "Crystal",
}
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeValue")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "JadeValue"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function closetScore(player)
	local total = 0
	for attr, tier in pairs(OTHER_CLOSET) do
		if player:GetAttribute(attr) then total += CLOSET_POINTS[tier] end
	end
	if _G.JadeGetClosetRarity then
		-- Script 51 returns skin points; the loop above already
		-- counted attribute cosmetics, so pass 0 extra.
		total += _G.JadeGetClosetRarity(player, 0)
	end
	-- The ONE Singular closet item in the game is a form, not a
	-- purchase: Oakley's skeleton is displayed as the Legend
	-- (Chapter 48), above and outside this ranked board.
	return total
end
local function compute(player)
	local lifetime = _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
	local swingScore = math.floor(lifetime / 10)
	local timeScore = (playMinutes[player] or 0) * 2
	local closet = closetScore(player)
	local value = math.floor(0.50 * swingScore + 0.25 * timeScore + 0.25 * closet)
	return {
		Name = player.Name, Value = value,
		Swings = swingScore, Time = timeScore, Closet = closet,
		Lifetime = lifetime, PlayMinutes = playMinutes[player] or 0,
	}
end
local function publish()
	board = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		table.insert(board, compute(p))
	end
	table.sort(board, function(a, b) return a.Value > b.Value end)
	for rank, entry in ipairs(board) do
		entry.Rank = rank
		local p = Players:FindFirstChild(entry.Name)
		if p then
			p:SetAttribute("CharacterValue", entry.Value)
			p:SetAttribute("ValueRank", rank)
		end
	end
	remote:FireAllClients("Board", board)
end
_G.JadePublishValue = publish
_G.JadeGetValueBoard = function() return board end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return store:GetAsync("u_" .. player.UserId) end)
	playMinutes[player] = (ok and data and tonumber(data.PlayMinutes)) or 0
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
		if root then lastPos[player] = root.Position end
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("u_" .. player.UserId, { PlayMinutes = playMinutes[player] or 0 })
	end)
	playMinutes[player], lastPos[player], moved[player] = nil, nil, nil
end)
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local root = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and lastPos[p] then
				if (root.Position - lastPos[p]).Magnitude > 5 then
					playMinutes[p] = (playMinutes[p] or 0) + 1
				end
				lastPos[p] = root.Position
			end
		end
		publish()
	end
end)
print("[Jade Spirit] Character Value ready -- swings 50, time 25, closet 25.")
